text: Wa noorempwa, masiyentiixita a Exikola ya Metisiina wa exikola ya osoma wuulupale ya Stanford aalaleerya mupakeliyo wa ekaruma ya tiyakonooxitiku onitthuna othoonyiherya iseelula mwa mithinto: exiipi yaamukhaani enimpirimereya enitthuna opakiwa erumeeliwaka imperesoora jaatu wa etinta eneeneene enitthuna ophiyererya esentaavu  emosa ya etoolare.

text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Itokumentu sinooniherya wiira ipanku miloko ni xexe sihaakhaliherya makiliyente aya oothaaciri ovitha ipiliyawu sa itoolare sa omukoni sa waameerika wi ohilivase mpooxito wala milivelo sikinaku sa kuveerunu.

text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Atthu akinaku, omutakanxeryaka John Grant, onikhupaliwa wiira kihaana muthowelo wa musurukhu okathi okhumelenlaaya muvirikano muhina mwa filosofiya a porokaramasawu amusomo wa televisawu vasokhannaaya wiira emale eseeriye.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Mwenye Reid waahiwerya weettiha mukukutta GP wa A!, Black Beauty, ni muvavihelo wa160 km wa khula ewoora wa ivaara thanu ni piili oviraka vaponti.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Mapoliisiya a Onoova Selantiya yaahikhalana mulatthu wiira yaarumeele akapwitthi aya a rataari anoona mwaakuvelo wa mukukutta a Sr. Reid waarowa mwaha wa mukhuveelo wa Black Beauty ti, ni ekwaha emosa mapuliisiya yaawenryaaya omuvariha Sr. Reid okathi waavukunlaawe mpakha  160 km/h..

text: Anamatthukweliwa oophiyeryaka 80 aakumihiwa Osenteraali wa Ireseeriva voohoothereriwa wuumaleloni wa miyeeri miraru.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Apiriili wa mwaakha ola, wa murumeelo wa mukottiho woohipisa okumihiwe ni namaphuka milattu Glynn muhia mwa inxitalasawu wiira okhanyererye akumihiwe anamatthukweliwa ale yaavirin'he iwoora 24 anari mukhatteya, ahiiweleliwe ni komisaariyu wa etiripunaali.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Komisaariyu onilamula efiyansa, yatthuniheriwa, ni onipakelela myoothereryo sithoonyiheriwe ni ofisiyaali muhoolela wa ekhatteya. Myoothereryo siniheliwa musixiteemani sotthokihereriwa ya exitaatu okathi oniveleeliwaaya mulattu.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Mukumanelo ola tho woomarakhari nihiku na mphuko oowaakuveya, ehakhi ya namoothereriwa.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, namuweha muhakhu mmosa a Awuxitaraaliya ni mulopwana oowaattana mulipelelo wa ohalana nipuro na miniixituru-oopacerya John Howard  nkhama mukhulupale wa eparitiitu liperaali, oolavula namakhaliherya awe wa moonaneyo wa intuuxitiriya ya nerexiya nukeleyaari Waawuxitaraaliya.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mwenye Costello waakhulenle wiira exerasawu ya enerexiya nukeleyaari yakhala yooreerela ekonomikamente, Awuxitaraaliya ohaana ophavela orumeela.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Eyo yakhala komerisiyaali, hiyo nihaana okhalana. Wala, mwa mwaha woohikhalana mukacamiho wa enerexiya nukeleyaari", wooleeliherya mwenye Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat khuwaavulanle noomwiira asitente.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Wa mwaha finaseyira a moolumwenkuni, Zapatero nlelo ookhupaleela wiira " esixiteema finanseyiru ti mpantta wa ekonomiya, mpantta wooreerexa".
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Nihaana muthowelo finanseyira mwaakha wootheene, waarina okathi awe wootepexa okhala mwaaleyiwe wuumaleloni wa miyeeri miili, ni  kinoona wiira niinaano va imerekaatu finanseyira soopacerya openuwa.
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Esumana evinre,  Naked News waahihimeerya wiira waamurowa wuncererya nvarihano awe ooruuha mihupi ni mattaava a ilapo sa okhopela, ni itaranximitasawu sa niinaano tthaaru.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Olavulaka ni inkeleexi ni exaponeexi, mukhaliheryo a olumwenku oniira waaruuhaka aporokaraama ni nttaava na exipanyoole, italiyaanu ni koreyaanu muhina mwa etelevisawu, interineeti ni ikaruma sineetta.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Wa ocaaliya, khiivo ekikhumelenle, masi miyo kihoona etthu yoohiloka, okathi atthu yaattehaaya okwanyula ixanela wiira akhumi.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Atthu yaanipwexana muviituruni ni ikhukulu, masi ixanela iya khisaakhwen'ye wiira sihononiye.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Wa ivitaraasa kamosa kamosa yaahiphweeya, ni awosa apaceryasa okhumasa vaxanelani", waahihimya namoopowa  Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Itthineeri sinnikokoliha ni oviha mwaha wa mwiiwanano (wala efusawu) ya enerexiya enipakiwa ni aatomo a itoroxeeniyu, eakaka siiso ikaruma sootepexa olemelela.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Masiyentiixita aniira avaraka muteko wiira apake ereyatoore enipaka enerexiya wa mananna mamosaru.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Ela, wa siiso, mulattu wootepa otikiniha muphukelo aya ni sinookela ovira miyaakha sinceene nihinatthi woona mupakeliyo wa ireyatoore sa efusawu sooreerela.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Esikano ya aasu enaaphempa vasulu wa maasi mwaha wa etensawu vasuperifiisiyeni.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Etensawu ya esuperifiisiye enikhumelela okhala wiira imoleekula sa maasi osuperifiisiye sinikhala waatarayiriwa ikina ni ikina, ovirikana imoleekula sa epheyo siri vasuluvaya.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Imoleekula sa maasi sinipaka ekamaata ehinooneya vasulu wa maasi, enitthuniherya wiira itthu sintoko akulya siphempeke vasulu wa maasi.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Elaamina ya patins ya exeelo yookhalana ikuume piili ni ekavitaate eriyari. Iyo sookhalana mupatelelo aya wooreerela muxeeluni, onuuramakaru.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Ni mpantta a wiikhaani wa elaamina ti wookhoropana, ettharihaka elaamina okathi enikelaaya othetemana wa mpantta ni mpantta mukina, ni tho mpantta oninyakelela exeelu onnikuruvari.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Eyo ti enimwiiriha patinatoore wiirukunxela. Ipatins sathetemanela mpantta woomulopwana, patinatoore onrukunuwela mpantta woomulopwana, nto Ipatins sakela othetemanela mpantta wa omuthiyana, patinatoore oniirukunxela moono wa omuthiyana.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Wiira otthikele mwinnuwelo wa enerexiya yoottuli, waamureerela omaliha ekhaaraka eexitara yaakheliwe ni mmwaleelo.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Awosa anipakasa eyo ahelelaka mpantta mwaamukhaani wa mmwaleelo onaasimiwa "fóton".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Masiyentiixita anaasimela eporoseesu eyo ya "muhelelelo ootumereriwa wa eratiyasawu" ni maatomo anitumereriwa ni mmwaleelo woowaarya, epacaka muhelelelo wa fóton wa mmwaleelo, ni mmwaleelo ti muthinto wa eratiyasawu.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Ncampulo ninttharelana ninwooniherya maatomo ahelelelaka  fótons. Ayo, veekeekhayi, fótons ti sootepexa oyeva ovirika iyo siri valataratoni.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fótons ti sootepexa oyeva ovirikana iparitiikula sinaapaka maatomo!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Noovira okathi munceene sivaraka muteko, efiiyu ya elampata ennivya, ni elampata khenivara tho muteko.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Wa siiso elampata enniphaveleya waakakhanihiwa. Vannireerela okhalana mwiinanelo waakakhanihaka elampata.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Opacerya, exaavi ya iluminaariya ehaana okhala yoottipihiwa wala ekaapu, yoottipihiweene.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Eyo ennikhumelela ni eleteresitaati ennikela musoketeni, weyiwo onikhalaaya mpantta wa eyuuma ya elampata, enitthunaaya oruuhela exookhi yuulupale eleetiriku, nyuwo mwavaravale muhina mwa esokete wala epaasi ya eyuuma ya elampata, eyo yeera enaheleliwe vasoketeni.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Etthu yuulupale muhina mwa esixiteema ahu sirikulatooriyu ti murima, okhanle ti oninseelela murima.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ephome eneetta mpakha ophiya vamurimani eviraka mutuupuni muniitthaneliwa ariteeriya  ni yakhuma vamurimani enivira mutuupuni munaasimeliwa mitika. Ituupu icikhaani ti sinaasimeliwa ivaasu kapilaare.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Mayino a tricerátops yaaniwerya onyakatta ohiya paahi makukhu, masi tho ikaalyu  ni mitathaari sootepexa olipa.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Asuweli makinaku anooniherya wiira tricerátops saalya isikateeseya, muthinto mmosa wa mwiri weesa wooneya okathi wa Keretaaseyo.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Miri iyo siinilkana vakhaani ni epalimeyira ekhaani ni ekoopa ya makukhu pontuuta ni oothikila.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Etiriseratoopi yaakela orumeela muthokowelo aya woolipa wiira ekumihe makukhu ehinatthi olya erikittili.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Masiyentiixita makinaku anihimya wiira miri iyo khasireere okhala evenenu, nto iyo khisikhanle soolyiwa ni tinasowuru kamosa kamosa, onasuweleyakaru wiira olelo inama sintoko eperekiisa ni papakayiyu (amusi a matinasowuru) otthuna olya makukhu wala mihokorokho sookhalana evenenu.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Yaakela okiphwanya sayi ekaravitaate ya lo? Nyuwo mwakhala vasulu wa lo, waamukhalana mulemelelo mwaamukhaani ovirikana vatthayani.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Mutthu orina mulemelelo wa iliipara 200 (90 kg) elapo ya vathi waakela olemelela 16 kg vasulu wa lo. Enimaliheriwa wiira ekaravitaate ti enimulemeleliha vakhaani.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Nsuwo khinirina nikula sintoko varinaaya Etthaya, weyiyo atthu aniphavelaaya okhala.  Nsuwo ti nookhalana ikaaxi, mooro ni epalaaxima.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Kaaxi ti onimalela oyeva okathi nyuwo munikhalaanyu ottyaawene ni nsuwa.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Mpantta wa ota ninwehaahu noonaka nsuwa onaasimeliwa fotoxifeera, onihimya "poola wa mmwaleelo".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Wa miyaakha soophiyeryaka ikonto tthaaru, wa 1610, axitoroonomu italiyaanu Galileo Galilei  waahirumeela etelexikoopiyu wiira woone  wi Veenu, siiso tho ni nsuwa, nookhalana okathi aya.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Okathi owo onikhumelela okhala wiira mpantta wa Veenu paahi (wala wa Mweeri) otthikelaka onsuwani onoomwaleeliwa. Okathi wa Veenu waakhaliherya eteyoriya Kopeeriniku wi ipalaneeta sinirukurerya nsuwa.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Siiso, noovira miyaakha miyaakha sene, mwa 1639, axitoroonomu inkeleexi wiitthaniwa Jeremiah Horrocks waahoona mweemelelo wa Veenu.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Noovira ekonkiixita ya Danelaw, Winkalateera khiwaareere akhala mahiku manceene oomaaleleya.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Siiso, mwa 991, waari eforota yuulupale viking  yeeyo Ethelred waahoolenlyaawe okhuma okathi wa Guthrum, ehinatthi ophiya eseekulu.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Eforota eyo yeettihiwa ni Olaf Trygvasson, anoruwekeexi ni ikuru soophavela woopola elapo awe mmatatani mwa tinamarikeesa.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Noovira okathi wa ikuru sa masupayi, waahiweryaneya wi Ethelred ovaanela ni ovariha noolumo nooreera ni Olaf, ori ti waatthikenle Onoruweeka wiira waxintte emwene awe, ni wamphiyereryo wooreerela.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ti alifapeetu mmosa opakeleliwe wiira orumeeliweke wa khula nihiku na atthu. Alifapeetu opakeleliwe mwaakha 1444 okathi wa omwene wa mwene Sejong (1418 - 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mwene Sejongue  waari mwene wa neexexe wa Dinastia Joseon ni ti ootepexa osiveliwa ni atthu.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Owo waahiwiitthanela orixinalimente alifapeetu Hangeul de Hunmin Jeongeum, onihimya "masu a ekeekhayi wa muleelelo wa atthu".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Khasireere iteyoriya sinceene sinilavula sa mukhumelelo wa Sânscrito. Wa kamosaru aya ti sa emikarasawu ariyaana a oweexite okelaka Wintiya akuxanse malavulelo aya.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sânscrito ti nttaava na khalayi noolikanihiwa ni Latim naalavuliwa weewuroopa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Eliivuru yookhalayi yoosuwelaxiwayaalepiwe ni Sânscrito Vano noopakiwa mutakanxeryo wa  Upanixades, sânscrito onahaleela mureerelo wa iyerarikiya.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sânscrito ti nttaava noothaaciri ni nootikiniha, nikhanle nipattunxe mattaava a niinaano Owintiya, siiso nkhama Latim nipattunxe mattaava a weewuroopa nkhama efaranseexi ni exipanyoole.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Noomala epataalya ya Ofaransa, Alemaaanya opacerya wiilokiherya wiira omwinvatiri Grã-Bretanha.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemaanya waamwiihanenle ataaki nkhama "Operasawu Sealion”. Wa mpantta muulupale aakapwitthi oolemela ni wa isupirimentu sa Exeerisitu Piritaaniku yaasuweliwe okhala oorimeela okathi awo yaaphavelaaya wiikumiha Otunkeeriki, ti vo exeerisitu yaaryaaya yoolosowa.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Masi Mariinya Mwaneeneene waari ootepexa owali ovirikana Mariinya a Waalemaanya ("Kriegsmarine") ni waanipwanyula wa khula eforota yaaveleeliheriwa wiira ekwanyule Ekanaali ya Manxa.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Wa siiso, miyaatiya vakhaani sa Mariinya Mwaneeneene yaarisi oowaatarakariwa waattamela iroota sa invasawu, okhala alipa animweettiha yaanoova ocamihiwa ni ataaki a misulu a waalemaanya.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Nrowe nipacerye ni exipalanasawu wa miruku sa Wiitaaliya. Itaaliya waari mutthu ni murokora awe ni Alemaanya ni Xapawu.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Sinapakiwakaru miyaatiya mixexe misya ekhotto ehinapacerya, yaahikhala exeerisitu ni mariinya oolosowa.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Miphiyereryo suulupale sa Wiitaaliya saari ni ilapo sa waafirika. Wiira yaavarakase, awo yaarowa ophavela okhalana epalatafooruma ya mukumiheryo wa atoropa, wiira aphiye ephareya Metiteraaniyu ni omwinvatiri aafirika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ti vo, owo yaahirimeelasa ni ipaasi ni miyaatiya piritaaniku ni Exiipitu. Ohiya wa soovarasaya isso, miyaatiya sa ekhotto sa wiitaaliya khisaamanle ovara tho itthu sikinaku.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Vano Oxapawu. Xapawu waari elapo insulaare, nkhama Reyinu Uniitu.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Masupumariinu ti imparakasawu soopakiwa wiira seetteke mukwaha aya vathi wa maasi ni okhala mwemmo mpakha okathi munceene.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Masupumariinu yaarumeeliwe ekwaha Yoopacerya ni ya Nayili ya Ikottho Muntiyaali. Okathi ole, khiyaaweryasa weetta ni yaahikhalana ekampu ya etiiru yoohikelela ottyaawene.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Okathi epacenryaaya ekhotto, awo yeettasa ekwaha otepexa waya mmaasini, wa sootheene, okathi rataari opacenryaawe wiixinnuwiha ni oohavelexiwa, wiira ohooniwe, masupumariinu yaahikhanyereruwa wiira apwinase.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Masupumariiu a Waalemaanya yiitthaneliwa "U-boats". Maalemaawu yaakhala osuwela wooperari ni waanavekari masupumariinu aya.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Wa exariya yooreerela ya masupumariinu, noomala ekhotto, atthu khiyaakhupali wiira maalemaanya khiyaareerani masupumariinu.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ayo! Mwene Tutancâmon, okathi mukinaku onaasimiwa "Mwene Tut" wala "Namittompe Farawo", ti mamwene kamosa kamosa  Ookhalayi ootepexa osuweliwa Wiixiipitu okathi wa niinaano.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Vootikiniheya, owo khiwooniwa okhala mutthu owaasivela atthu okathi wa khalayi ni waaphwanyaneya onalepiwe muhina mwa iliixita sinceene sookhalayi.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Wa sootheene, mooneneliyo wa mahiye awe mwaakha 1922 waahimutatuxa okhala mutthu oosuwelaxiwa. Onasuwanyeyakaru wiira mahiye oowaatta ookhalayi ahiiyiwa, masi yawawe khiyaavariwe.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Wa itthu soowaatta soowin'heeleliwa ni Tutancâmon saari soowinxaatheya oratteene, sitakanxereyaka ikaruma sinceene iwooro ni maluku oorika ophwanya.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Mupakelelo wa mattheko ni irayiyu sooruuhela ikaruwaaxi okhala soopeepheya, soowaakuvexa ni soolokiheriwa oratteene wiira saavikane masulutaatu ni ikaruwaaxi sikinaku.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Ifelexa sa aaruku ayasa siniiva saanimuttemula aarumatuura a masulutaatu aniwananaaya. Wa mwaakha 1000 a.C., masiiriyu yaahooniherya ikavalariya soopacerya.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Ekavalariya ti nikhuru na anakhotto aniwana ni ikhavalo. Eseela nlelo yeera ehipakeleliwe, nto exeerisitu siiriyu, wiira ewane, yaakavalakari vasulu wa ittuli sa ikhavalo saya.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Niinaasuwela mapuliitiku anceene, masiyentiixita ni maaritiixita makereku. Vanikhala ntoko, mutthu oosuwelaxiwa a ewahala eyo ti Homero, lentaariyu puweta ahoona waarina iwoopora pirima piili sa literatuura kereka: ipoweema  Ilíada ni Odisseia.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sófocles ni Aristófanes nlelo mataramatuuruku oosuwelaxiwa, ni ikaruma saya ti soosuwelaxiwa okhala miteko sooreerexa muhina mwa literatuura muntiyaali.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Kereku mukina oosuwelaxiwa ti matemaatiku Pitágoras, oosuweliwa mwaha wa mureerelo wa etiyoreema awe ya mipantta sa anamalootho mararu ni anamalootho maxexe.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Sookhala miyuupuwelelo soowaatta wa nummeru na atthu anilavula nttaava na Ehinti. Onuupuweleliwa wiira ti nttaava na nayili wala na neexexenoolavulexiwa moolumwenkuni.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Nummeru na axineene anilavula ninvirikana ni malavulelo aniira mpantta wa mwaalakelo wala hooye.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Miyaanyiheryo sinivirikana okhuma imilyawu 340 ni imilyawu 500 sa atthu anilavula ni mpakha imilyawu 800 sa atthu aniiwa naalavuliwa nttaava.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Ehinti ni Uurutu sinoolikana muvokapulaariyuni, masi sinivirikana malepeliyo aya; mwa mivaanelo sa nihiku, anamalavula a mattaava oomayili ala anniiwanana mukina ni mukina.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Okathi wa miyaakha imiya XV, omukoni wa Exitooniya yaari mapuro maalupale a iwahala sa waalemaanya.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Mamonxe makinaku a waalemaanya yaatthuna omwaattamela Muluku a axineene elapo, nto awo anapakelela nttaava exitoniyaanu.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Neera mpantta wa alifapeetu a waalemaanya ni karaatere mmosa  "Õ/õ" waahiheleliwa.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ni wuuvirani wa okathi, malove manceene aphattunwe muhina mwa nttaava na waalemaanya ahiixuttiwa. Eyo waari okathi woopacerya wa iluminiiximu.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Taratisiyonalimenti, mulipa oohalana omwene waamukela orowa weexeerisitu noomaliha osoma.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Wa sootheene, Charles oosoma Wuuniverisitaati wa rinity College, Cambridge, weyiwo omusommyaawe Antoropoloxiya ni Arikiyoloxiya, ni tho Exitooriya,  oxinttaka 2:2 (tipolooma mmosa a ekalaase ya nayili).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles waari mutthu oopacerya muhina mwa Amusi a Ekeekhayi a Opiritaanika waasomme exikola yuulupale mpakha omaliha.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turukiya ewuropeyiya  (Taraasiya oriyentaali wala Rumeeliya openiisula wa Balcãs) onitakanxereya 3% wa enasawu.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Muttetthe wa Oturukiiya ti muulupalexa ovikana ikiloometuru 1.600 (imiilya 1.000) wa murakamelo  ni 800 km (imiilya 500) wa mwaanuwelo aya, ohiya mukhalelo woolikana wa namalootho mararu.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Muttetthe wa Oturukiiya, otakanxeryaka miro, enikhalana 783.562 km² (300.948 mi²); 755.688 km² (291.773 mi²) sinihala osutuweexiti wa Aasiya ni  23.764 km² (9.174 mi²) sinihala Weewuroopa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Muttetthe wa Oturukiiya ti oniphiyereriha elapo okhala mapuru a 37º  wa soowinnuwa moolumwenkuni ni mwinnuwelo aya onoolikana a Ofaransa Metoropolitaana ni wa Reyinu Uniitu hoothe.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turukiiya orukureriwe ni iphareya wa mipantta miraru: Ephareya ya Exewu mpantta waoweexite, Ephareya Neekuru mpantta wa omukoni ni Ephareya Metiteraaniyu mpantta wa okuusini.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxempuurukhu ookhalana ehantisi epancenrye khalayi, masi moopowelo awe wiiranen'ye mwaakha wa 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Mipantta sa niinaano sa Opeelixika khalayi seera mpantta wa Oluxempuurukhu, masi vano sithatum'we okhala ipeelika nookhumelela Erevolusawu Peelika ya 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxempuurukhu okhuma khalayi waanitteha okhala elapo yoohaaluwa, masi yaahikuxiwa okathi wa Ikhotto Muntiyaali piili, ni Alemaanya.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Mwaakha wa 1957, Luxempuurukhu waari mempuru a mupakelelo wa mulokiheryo oosuwelaxiwa nihiku na olelo okhala Uniyawu Ewuropeyiya.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyel Dzong ti eforotaleesa yoowuntta ni monaxiteeriyu putiixita oniphwanyaneya osulu wa Etixitiriituya Opaaru (eniphwanyaneya Oviila Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Onihimwa wiira, eyaakha ya 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel waapakenle eforotaleesaela wiira othapeele niira noxitta  wa ekhotto yawana awe ni matipataana oMonkooliya.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Mwaakha wa 1951, mupattelo mmosa ti weerin'he sihalaka ireliikiya kamosa kamosa sa Drukgyal Dzong, sintoko efikura ya Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Nookhumelela mupattelo ola, eforotaleesa yaahikhapeleliwa ni olipiheriwa, ni yaapaken'ye okhala etthu yootepexa oreera ya Oputawu.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Wuuvirani wa mwaakha emiya XVIII, Ekampooca yaaphwanyaneya eriyari ya anamwaattamana oowaattana ikuru, Tayilantiya ni Viyetinaame.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Matayilanteexi yaahinvatiri Ekampooca ivaara sinceene miyaakha imiya 18 ni 1772 yaahikurumulasa Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Maviyetinaame tho yaahinvatiri Ekampooca wuumalelani wa miyaakha imiya XVIII.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Wa ipurusentu 18 sa mavenesuweela kharinasa miteko, ni omwaatteloni wa ale anivara muteko ti ale arina muteko ohinsuwanyeya.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Wa mpantta wa neeraru wa mavenesuweela anivarasa muteko ti ale aniira mpantta wa esetoore ya miteko, waattamela mpantta wa neexexe wa intuuxitiriya ni mpantta wa neethanu wa akirikulutuura.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Mureerelo mmosa wa intuuxitiriya ya mavenesuweela ti wa patarooya, yoowo elapo eniisaaya omutumiha, vanasuweleyakaru wiira epurusentu emosa ti enivara ni intuuxitiriya peteroliifera.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Wuupaceryani wa moopowelo waelapo, mutteho wa Oxariti Potaaniku wa Osinkapuura waahikhaliherya otatuxa eyiilya wa epooma emosa ya xariti toropikaali.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Mwaakha wa1981,  Vanda Miss Joaquim, iipirita mmosa wa orikiiteya, waahithanliwa okhala etuthu nasiyonaali ya elapo.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Miyaakha sootheene, okathi wa mweeri wa  Otuupuru, iriipivoru soophiyeryaka emiyawu 1.5 sinikhala weetta mukwaha sikelaka mpantta wa ipalaniisiye sa okuusini, silapuwaka Muru onaasimiwa Maara, sikhumaka miyaako sa omukoni, siphavelaka ipula.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Wa ottharelana, sinatthikela omukoni sikelaka oweexite, silapuwaka tho muro Maara, noorupa ipula sa Apiriili.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Mukano wa Serenxeeti wookhalana Epaariki Nasiyonaali ya Oserenxeeti, ni Nipuru na Mukhapelelo wa  Nkoronkooro, ni Ereseeriva ya Ekaasa Maswa elapo ya Otansaniya ni Ereseeriva Nasiyonaali Masaayi Maara elapo ya Okheeniya
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Oxutta opaka imiitiya soovaanelihana oniphaveleya osuwelexa wookhupaliwa ni taratisiyonaali, siiso ni osuwela ikaruma sa misomo soovaaneleya (exipoosu sekwensiyaali, etisawu ya awutiyu ni iviitiyu, olaphulela ithale, ni sikinaku.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Design  oovaaneleya onivaha miruku wiira nyuwo mooniherye tho isuposisawu sanyu muhina mwa eporotusawu ya emiitiya ni muupuwelele wa mananna oohinineya.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Design oovaaneleya oniphaveleya wi ikomponente sa poroxeetu sikumane ekina ni ekinaku, masi tho opakelela moonelo nkhama entitaate yoohiyaniheya.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Muhireerelo wa ilenti zoom okhalaka wiira mukacamiho aya fokaale ni nummeru na itthu sa ilenti sooreerela wiira siphiyererye iokaali ti wootepexa winnuwa ovirikana ilenti fiikixa.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Owo onipakeya mulattu mwaamukhaani, okathi anamapaka a ilente aniphiyereryaaya mireerelo soophaveleya okathi anipakaaya.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Eyo ti etthunin'henrye ilenti sa ekompilasawu opaka macampulo ni ekwalitaate yoolikanixeya ni ilenti fiikixa sinoona voorakamela.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Muhireerelo wa ilenti zoom okhalaka wiira mwaanuwelo (evelositaati) yoomalela ya elenti enikhalaka ekhaani.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Eyo ti eniiriha ilenti sa zoom sookhweya okacamiha muwareliyo aya variyari wa mikhalelo soohilokasa sa mukokolelo vanlakani voohirumeela flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Wa itiverisitaati sookhalexa saattehiwaka okonveriteriwa efiilime wi ekhalane foromaatu a DVD ti "overscan".
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Omwaatteloni wa itelevisawu sinipakiwa wiira saatthekuliheke atthu ootheene.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Mwa wa yeeyo, sootheene munaanaanyu muhina mwa TV sihaana ipoorota soowiikitthiwa, suulupale, icikhaani ni ilateraaxi.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Eyo enipakiwa wiira ncampula nimaleleke eteela yootheene. Eyo ti enaasimeliwa "overscan".
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Voohihakalaleya, nyuwo mwaamupakaka DVD, ipoorota sinimalela wiikitthiwa, ni eviitiyu yakhalana ilexenta waattamela vathi, iyo khasinkela okumiheriwa sootheene.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Ekaxiteelu yoosuwelaxiwa ya itaati meetiya  enithoonyiherya muupuwelo ti yookhalayi, ethukumanyihaka macampulo oolokiheriwa, axantaari ni ekavalariya arituriyaana.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Enakhalakaru yoowuntta ni yoovira miyaakha soowaatta, ti vookhweya wuupuwela minyakulo ni munkhelelo wa ipataalya soohaleeliwa khalayi, wiiwa minyakulelo sa ikaaxiku mmalukuni mwa ikalasamentu ni mpakha  wunkha epavoore ya makhwelo a imaximoora.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Masi muupuwelo ahu ti wa ekeekhayi? Mwaha wa xeeni ikaxiteelo saatekiwaaya, mwa nipuro noopacerya? Iyo yaatesenyariwe sayi  ni saatekiwe sayi?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tiipiku ya okathi,  Castelo Kirby Muxloe ti empa yootepexa olipa ovikana ekaxiteelo ya ekeekhayi.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Ixanela saya suulupale sooheliwa iviituru ni ixiri saamukhaani khisaavilenle okathi okhumelenlyaawe ataaki waakhumelenle khalayi.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Mwaaka wa 1480, okathi waapaceriwaaya otekiwa ni Lord Hastings, elapo yaari yoomaaleleya ni mulipiheryo aya waari paahi wa makhuru makhaani wa alipa ale anikhala wiiya.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Ekiliipiriyu ya ekuru yaari esixiteema ilapo sa weewuroopa saaphavelaaya opwehererya esoperaniya nasiyonaali ya ixitaatu sootheene sa weewuroopa.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Muruku waari wa ilapo sootheene sa weewuroopa wi ehihiyereriwe nnakhala elapo emosa ekhalanaka ikuru ni, siiso, makuveerunu nasiyonaali yaanaakakhana onthamwene aya wiira akhalane ekiliipiriyu emosaru.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ekhotto ya Esusesawu Exipanyoola yaahimarakhari ekhotto yoopacerya ni mulattu wa eriayari waari wa ekiliipiriyu ya ikuru.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Owo waari maaruku ooreerexa, nto niinaano va ikuru sa weewuroopa khisaakela okhalana tho ithiru sa etiini wi sipacerye owaniha. Wa siiso, Ekhotto ya Miyaakha Miloko Miraru yaarowa okhala ekhotto yookhiserya ya itiini.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Etempulu ya Ártemis wa Éfeso yaakwanyuliwe mahiku yeettaka 21 mweeri wa xuunyu 356 a.C. nimooro wa ekhirini waapattihiwe ni Heróstrato.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Sintoko vanihimyaaya ethale, etthu yaamwiirin'he ophavela okhalana efaama, wa itthu sootheene. Moofeesiyu, oonanariweene, yaahilakelasa ohimya wiira nsina na  Heróstrato khinaakhalakhala nikaravariwaka.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Mulipa a ihantisi sa Okereesiya Exitarabawu waahilamula nsina nawe, niri ti ninsuweliwa mpakha olelo. Etempulo yaapwanyulasiwe ohiyu yoole waayariwaawe Alexandre  Muulupale.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandre, nkhama mwene, waahiivahererya olima mutekeliyo wa etempulu, masi atthu yaahimukhottela. Okathi mukinaku, nookhwa Alexandre, etempulu yaahitthikeliwa otekiwa mwaakha wa  323 AC.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Mwiivarelele wiira ntata nayu wi nikhale noohikhulumuwa, mulipelelaka ophiyererya inoota sootheene voolikaneya - muttehe tho, ohiitannya woowaatta ni ikokho sanyu.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Wa mananna awo, nyuwo munookela wiilipiherya. Wiira wuncererye mwinnuwelo, woopuweleke wiira khivaniphaveleya otthiteerexa itekalaatu ni ikuru soowaatta, sintoko mpiyaanuni.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Wiira okhalane tho evolume okoroteyawunu, orumeele efoole ni eperesawu yoowaatta wala evelositaati.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mixitixiiximu ti mphavelo wa mwaakhelelo wa muluku , wa itentitaati wala mwiiwelelo wa muupuwelo wa ekeekhayi ookhiserya, wa emuluku, wa ekeekhayi ya erooho yoowaarya wala ya Muluku.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Namaswali onirowela mutteho mmosa, mulohelo wa meelo wala wiiwelela ni osuwela wa ekeekhayi ya muluku/ ya olompa wala milompelo.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Anamattharelela anirowelaka makhalelo makinaku a ekumi wala soovara wiira yooniherye mitteho iyo.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mixitiiiimu pooti wooniwa ni mananna makinaku a malompelo ni mukhupalelo wala itiini mwaha wa mutteho wa khula mutthu wa mukhalelo woowuupuwela mmosaru, otepexa waya ale ooreera murima, oowaakuva oxutta, oohakalala wala ookhala oratteene.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhiiximu ti etiini ya osupukontinenti ya wintiya. Eyo ekhumelenle mukano wa Punjab okathi ole wa imiya 15, enikhuma muhina mwa mukawanyeyo setaarika a etaratisawu hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Masikhs anihimyasa wiira waamini waya ti etiini yoosuwanyeya ya hintuwiiximu, sinasuweliyakaru mitathaari saya ni itaratisawu hindus.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Masikhs etiini aya aniitthanelasa Gurmat, enihimya "ephiro ya Kuuruo" mwa punjabi. Kuuru ti mukhalelo mmosa wooreerela muhina mwa itiini sootheene sa wintiya, masi, Oxikhiiximu, owo ookhapelela mureerelo onittottelela enuukiliyu ya malompelo Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Etiini yaapakeleliwe oseekuluni. XV mwaha wa Kuuru Nanak (1469-1539). Makuuru mathanu ni maxexe yaahihalanihiwa okhuma vaavo.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Siiso, mweeri wa Xuunyu wa 1956, miroromeliho sa Krushchev  saahiheleliwa mporovani okathi marepeeliti a Opolooniya , weyiwo anamuteko yenlaseyaaya mwaha wa muthowelo wa yoolya ni mithikilelo sa esalaariyu, saapaken'ye okhala munlaseyo wa atthu ootheene mwaha wa komuniiximu.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Onasuweleyaku wiira wuumaleloni, Krushchev  waahiveleeliha itanki wiira olokiherye ewooriti, owo waahikhupalela itthu sikinaku saaphaveliwa mwaha wa ekonomiya  ni wahikupali omuthanla Benquisto Wladyslaw Gomulka wiira okhala miniixituru- oopacerya.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Esivilisasawu ya Ovaale wa Indo yaari esivilisasawu ya Okathi wa Eporonse onoroweexiti wa esupukontinenti intiyaanu, ephwanyaka mpantta munceene olelo ori Opakixitawu  ni mikanu sikinaku onoroweexiti wa Wintiya ni onoroweexiti wa Afikanixitawu.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Esivilisasawu yookuttuwela muhina mwa ipasiya sa muro Indo, ti vo nsina naya.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Wa anamasoma oowaatta anihimya wiira, okhala wiira isivilisasawu tho saahikhala mpasiya  mwa muro Sarasvati, yooloka waari waasimela esivilisasawu Indo-Sarasvati, ni akinaku anaasimeela esivilisasawu Erapiyaana, mwaha wa Harappa, mapuru oopacerya kamosa kamosa a maakha wa 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Mutteho wa masupayi a impeeriyu Romaanu waahikhaliherya mmwinnuweloni wa mukelela wa ohoolo  a metisiina.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Matothoro anapaceriwa orekurutariwa ni imperatoore Augusto e mpakha oforomariwa Ekoorupu Meetiku Romaanu wiira awareke noomala epataalya.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Masuruxiyawu yaahisuwelasa mimaaleleyo soovirikana, otakanxereyaka morifiina, okumihiwe mpapowulani, ni exikopolamiina, okumihiwe munukuni wa miri.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Awo yaahipakeyasa okhala maporofisiyonaali oowiikittha wiira yoopole ikumi sa arettha yaarina kankereena, mpakha ni itorinikeeti ni ipinsa ariteriyaali wiira sikhapelele ekhumelo ya ephome.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Wuuvirani wa miyaakha sinceene, Impeeriyu Romaanu yaahiphiyererya mireerelo suulupale muhina mwa metisiina ni waahipaka ipaasi suulupale mpantta wa musuwelo nirinaahu mpakha olelo.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Origami Pureland muvarelo wa origami okhanle ti onipakiwa mukhunelo evaara emosa paahi. Ohiya tho vo, mikhunelo sootepexa otikiniha, nkhama mikhunelo reveerisa ti sookottihiwa ni itoopora sootheene sookhalana miphwanyaneyo soonineya.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Waapakiwe ni John Smith emiya ya mwaakha wa 1970 wiira okhaliherye mirupa sahaasuwela saana  wala atthu ale yaasuwela wa mananna oolimitareya.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Anamwane anninnuwiha osuwela waya ni ixitereyotiipu rasiyaali, ni ixitereyotiipu rasiyaali iyo sinniphiya mmukhaleloni.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Sintoko, anamwane aniixooniherya okhalana ni erasiyaali vakhaani ekhanle ti exitereyotipaata mwaha woohiphiyererya musuwelo saana oxikola mwaha woowiiraka wi awo yasuwela vale wiira exitereyotiipu eniira mpantta ni eraasa aya.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ti esayiti yoosuwelaxiwa enirumeeliwa muhina mwa Ixitaatu Uniitu ni yookhalana imilyawu 54 ya iperifiili wa niinaano va.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Esayiti iyo sinikhala waakhelela mwiiwelelo, otepexa waya onlakani wa musomo.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Sookhala mireerelo muhina mwa iweepisayiti iya, wa imosaru aya okhala muweryelo woopakiwa epaaxina ya misomo blogs, iviitiyu, ifootu ni irekuurusu sikinaku.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Epaaxina eyo pooti okeliwa wa mananna ooreerela, etthu enitthunaneya ovaha entereesu ya weepi, eri ti etthu eniwiiriha anaxikola akhalanaka mukelelo oowaakuveya arina mikacamiho wa soolepa wala murumeelo wa etekalaatu.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Onnireerela okhalana eperisonalisasawu wiira ekhaliherye esomelo, ni makhwili vakhaani, nkhama vaniphaveleyaaya.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Mukacamiho wa Déficit wa Mwiiwelelo "ti sintorome sereparaali yeeyo etiriyaati ya etifinisawu kalaasika ya miwereyelo sinitakanxerya impulisivitaati, etixitarasawu ni iperativitaati wala mwaattelo wa enerexiya."
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Khohiyo orakala, mukacamiho wa muxuttelo; owo "onaafetari wa 3% a 5% wa anamwane ootheene, otakanxeryaka imilyawu 2 sa anamwane a waameerika".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Anamwane ni DDA aakhalana mikacamiho ni opaka miteko sa oxikola, masi anikhala osiveliwa yaapakaka itthu sinoonaaya wiira sinnaasivela, sintoko omuttikha mphira, owoona apuneku oowaasivela wala olepa moolunu oohikhalana ekhomo.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Anamwane awo anikhalana mikacamiho soowaatta, okhala wiira "waasivela orukuneyela itthu soowoopiha, muuwanani ni waathamaleela mawutoritaati" wiira attehe muupuwelo aya, ohikhanle oottehiwa ni itthu sooreerela.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: DDA onaafetari mipatthanano ni axipatthani akinaku okhala wiira anamwane akinaku khanisuwela mwahaaya oothamaleya wa mananna anitthamaleyaaya wala mwaha woonyakula  nkhama vaninyakulaaya wala mwinnuwelo aya ti woovirikana.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Sintoko muweryelo oophwanya musuwelo ni muxuttelo oovirikaniha mananna alavuliwe osulu, etaaxa ya ophwanya musuwelo woovirikana.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Muphwanyeryo wa mihupi waari oovirikana. Khiwaari tho mwaha wa muupuwelo wa naveekhaawe, muweryelo a wuupuwela mutthaka waahixintta mureerelo muulupale.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Pasikamenti, Renayisimentu woopaka muvirikaniho wooreerela muhina mwa mihupi sa oxuttaniwa ni wa mwaalaanyeyo wa muxutto.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Ovirikana mapirimaata makina, moominiiteyo khaneetta tho ni matata aya, mulyelyo woolemelela, wala wiithomeya mmwirini.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Ntata ni mwetto wa khole muulupale sinoolikana mwinnuwelo aya, murumeelo wa matata oni okhaliherye mulemelelo aya yeettaka ni ikatha.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Ntata na mutthu ti nootepexa okhuveya ovirina mwetto, ni ifalanxi sootepexa wookololeya.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Makhuva a atthu ookhwa oovira imilyawu piili wala imilyawu tthaaru sa miyaakha annithoonyiherya mivirikano iyo wa miteko saarinaaya matata ooweettana  mpakha wa soovara saya ni matata.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Atthu akinaku annikhupali wiira okhalana miloho sooreera sineettiheriwa wa mananna oopakeleliwa ni atthu okathi mukinaku emmalela okhala etthu yooreera.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Mwaha muulupale wa mukhumelelo owo ti mwiiraneyo wa milohelo sooreerela, sinimwarya okathi ni ixitaatu REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Okhalana ikhove vakhaani REM wa khula ohiyu, ori ti okathi ole weyo onittehaawe okhalana ikhove sa ekeekhayi ni erutthu anyu enipenuwaaya, onimalela okhala okathi wooreerela wi ohiyanihe mikamiho sa ekumi.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Eyo ti etthu yoolamweya, okathi onivenyaawe wa khula iminuutu miloko miili wala miloko miraru ni omoona TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Mukhumelelo onittharihela mutthikeleyo wa muupuwelo awe onittehaawe opaka miloheryo sooreerela, wa khula ohiyu.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Itthu khasiiranen'ye voowaareerela miitaliyaanu a omukoni wa Aafirika okhuma wuupaceryani. Noovira esumana emosa waalakeliwaaya ekhotto ya Wiitaaliya mahiku yeettaka 10 mweeri wa Xuunyu wa 1940, 11º Hussardos mapiritaaniku yaahikuxa Ekapusu Yoolipa ya Oliipiya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Wa mwiipitheliyo wa oleexite wa Opaaritiya, mapiritaaniku yaahimuvara enxinyeeru xeefe wa Exeerisitu ya Namuloko italiyaanu, xeneraali Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Wa 28 wa Xuunyu, Marechal Italo Balbo,kuverinatoore xeraali a Oliipiya ni namuhalana muhakhu wa Mussolini, weyiviwe ni apatthani okathi waakhuruwaawe Otobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Exikiriima, nkhama mulipiheryo wa niinaano, onipakiwa wa minnuwelo soovirikana, sa anamasoma a univerisitaati, mpakha mixinttano sa muteko ni olimpika.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Mphira onipakiwa  wa mananna ooxinttaniwa, mukinaku ni mukinaku.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Koolidi ti mphira weyiyo anamaxinttana anirumeelaaya itaaku wiira yaarihaneke apoola mmwiitheni.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Wa evaara emosa ya atthu ootheene, anittikheliwa miyiithe thanu ni tthaaru. Anamattikha anipaceryasa omuttikhelasa mwiithe woopacerya a ekampu, ni anikhiserya mwiithe wa namuloko ni thanu ni tthaaru.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Namattikha onimmanakasa vakhaani, wala mittikinyeyo sa taaku, wiira omalelihe mweettelo, ti onixintta.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Mphira onisopheleleya okaramaatuni, ni ekaraama mukerekhere wa mwiithe ti onithikileleya ni onaasimeliwa yooripelela.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Mmalela, muthinto wa  eturiiximu woosuwelaxiwa onimalela okhala ole atthu anceene anitakanxeryaaya ni ikwaha saya: eturiiximu yoophavela otthekula.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Ti vo atthu anirowaaya mapuro oovirikana wa mapuru ale alimalenlyaaya wiira yamumule ni atthekule.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Iphareya, ipaarikhi temaatiku ni mapuro a mphira ti mapuro ootepexa oxukuriwa ni maturiixita wiira arowe yarukuneye.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Wa khala wiira mphiyereryo wa muxukuryo ola ti wa ophavela oxukurya nipuro ni osuwela ihantisi ni iwahala saya, weeso owo ti muthinto wa eturiiximu yoosuwelaxiwa okhala eturiiximu ya ewahala.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Maturiixita pooti oxukurya mapuro oovirikana a ikhomo turiixitiku sa elapo wala ophavela ottharatthara mpantta mmosa paahi.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Makolono, aweyaka miteko iyo, tho yaahivekela mulipiheryo.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Wa atoropa alipihenrye mipantta sa ohoolo saaphwanyaneya 1º ni 3º ireximentu sa New Hampshire, khula emosa yaakhalana masulutaatu 200 ni mihoolelo sa makoroneeli John Stark ni James Reed (oowayili anakhalasa maxeneraali).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Axilopwana a Stark  yaahiipithasa, wa exitereemu ya omukoni wa mpantta wa makolonisatoore.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Okathi niwimpi noottittha nitthukunlaaya elakuna okutoni wa muro Místico, mpantta wa onoriteexiti wa peninsula, awosa niinaanoru yaahaatalela eseerika ni exiri ekhaani ya maluku okelaka omukoni, emalelaka mukerekhere wa maasi wa ephareya ekhaani.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley wala Stark waahihela ekopo emosa ya murakamelo aya waaphiya metto 100 (30 m) ohoolo waarukureriwe ni waahiruma wiira ehoopiwe nnakhala etiiru emosa mpakha marekulaare aviranseene vaavale.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Muru wa maamerikaanu waalipelela ataaki ooreheriwa wa mipantta tthaaru soovirikana.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Xneraali John Cadwalder wammuhiyaniha ataaki a mwiipithelo wa atoropa piritaanika mukano wa Bordentown wiira sihikhumelele milipiheryo sikinaku.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Xeneraali James Erwin waamwaakuxa atoropa oophiyeryaka 700 mpakha mpantta mukinaku wamuru  Trenton Ferry, waamutominari eponte vasulu wa Assunpink Creek ni waamooniherya wiira atoropa aniwananaawe atthyawase.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Ekuru yuulupale ya ataaki yookhalana axilopwana 2.400 yaamulapuwa muru wa imiilya thanu ni ixexe omukoni wa Trenton,  ni yaamukawanyeya wa makhuru amayili, nimosa noohooleliwa ni  Greene  ni nikinaku noohooleliwa ni Sullivan, ni mphiyereryo woophavela opakiwa ataaki ohinatthi oxa.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ni muvirikaniho wa mweettelo - wa emiilya xexe ekuruxiwe mpakha emeya miilya -, mwaakuveyo opaken'ye okhala woohiphaveleyexa, ni mukhanyereryo opaken'ye okhala etthu yoophavelexiwa.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Vaasuwanyeya wiira ekoretoore yuulupalexa ya imeeturu 800, mulopwana oolikanana omaliherya moomolano wa iminuutu piili, ohaana owerya otthyawa, masi tho mukhanyereryo ohaana ophaveliwa.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Miyoomolano mikinaku Cross Country okathi wootepexa oriirya, oowiiwanana ni mayeso a mmakhuvani okelaka mpantta a wiilupale a erutthu, ti mulokiheryo wooreerela wa etemporaata ya moomolano.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Enutirisawu yoowiireerela ennikhaliherya mukhalelo muulupale, masi ommalela waafetari vooreera muhina mwa anamittompe ale ari maateleeta.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Omanteriki ekiliipiriyu enerexeetiku ya ekumi yooreera, okhalana ilimalelo sa owurya wurya maasi ni osuwela makhalelo oovirikana wa meettiheryo sa isupelementasawu simmalela waakhaliherya maateleeta wuncererya etesempeenyu aya ni wuncererya musiveleliyo aya ni mphira.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Moomolano wa murakamelo wookhuveela ti mphira ootepexa okhweya; wa sootheene, khasireere miiwelo soohiiwiya oratteene mwaha wa ikipamentu sooreerela vakhaani wiira okhalele.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Iporotuutu sinimalela othumiwa wa mphiyereryo oniphaveliwa, masi owaatta wala vakhaani khanirowa oruuha ikeekhayi siniphaveliwa.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Maateleeta animalela olavula wiira aniphavela eporotuutu emosa anasuwelakaru wiira awo khanivaha mireerelo siniphaveliwa.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atoomu onimalela wooniwa okhala mpantta wooreerexa wa emateeriya yootheene.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Nkhama onithoonyiheryaawe mukhalelo woohirika wa  Bohr, ti mpantta  wootepexa orika ori vanuukeleyoni senteraali oripitaatu ni elétrons, soolikana ni ipalaneeta sinooripitari nsuwa - owehe ncampulo1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nuukiliyu nookhalana iparitiikula piili - nêutrons ni prótons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Prótons sookhalana ekhaaraka eleetirika positiiva ni nêutrons  khasirina ekhaaraka. Elétrons sirina ekhaaraka nekatiiva.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Wiira omuphiyererye viitima, weyo oniphaveleya osoma toko etthu eyo wiira okhalane mulipiheryo.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Weyo ohaana woona mpantta wa viitima wa mwaattamela owo ni khula ekhomo yoowooneya ya ekaasoopelo.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Weyo woona owereya okathi oniphavelaawe omukhaliherya, weyo onikela otepiherya mwaha owo.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Musomo onihimya wiira eteperesawu, moovelo ni kataxitorofisasawu saaphima mupatthanano wa muwereelo ni ohiwerya wa atthu ale aniwereyiwa mutthana.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Mikhumelelo sa kataxitorofisasawu paahi, khasinruuhela eteperesawu ni moovelo, yaari oolokiheriwa ni isesawu rekulaari sa muteko fiisika semanaaxi soolokiheriwa.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Ale yaavara miteko saya mahiku ootheene yaaphavela esupooriti yuulupale, mukontho wa mwiiwelelo woohiloka wa muwereyelo, wiira avirikaniheke wa muwereelo woopisa omala ni moonelo woohikhala saana mwaha wa miteko sinivaraaya sookhala mwaaleyiwe.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Moonelo, wala muweryelo onnitthuniherya woona, onikhaliheriwa ni makhuru a itthu sinnitthuniherya woona, wala sa mayitho.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Khareere mananna oovirikana a mayitho, avirikana mirikelo saya ni atharihelaka simphavela erutth.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Makhalelo oovirikana aakhalana miweryelo soovirikana, ti soottettheya mhina mwa ikumpirimentu sa onta soovirikana ni sookhalana minnuwelo soovirikana sa akwitaate, ohiya tho vo, awo aniphavela okhalana muupuwelo woovirikana wiira ovahe moonelo wa mukelelo ni mammeru oovirikana wiira avareke muteko wa mananna ooreerela.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Nikhuru na atthu ti muthukumano wa mirutthu sa exipeesiye kamosa kamosa muhina mwa nipuro xeyokaraafika.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Atthu ootheene yakhalana nikhuru na atthu ootheene anikhala oolikana muhina mwa etarasu fenotiipiku yoosuwanyeya, awo anisuweliwa okhala nkhama moonomoriifiku.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Okathi atthu anithoonyiheryaaya ivariyanti soovirikana sa etarasu paritikulaare, awo anisuweliwa okhala mapolimoorifiku.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ikolooniya sa ineneele-koreyisawu sinneetta ni sinnipaka ipuuru okathi woovirikana.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Ineneele sa weexeerisitu sineetta ni ohiyu ni sinneemela wiira sikhalane mmumulelo wa nihiku na okathi woohikhalana nipuro.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Ekolooniya enipacerya okathi noomate itthu soolya savukuwavale. Okathi owo, awo anipaka ipwaaru ahinitthunaaya okhala mpakha khalayi sinaakakhanihiwa wa khula nihiku.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Wa khula emosa aya sa imanifexitasawu wala miyeettelo noomate sinipisa mahiku 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Eseelula ti exeeni? Nlove seelula ninkhuma muhina wa "cella", wa olatim, enihimya "ekoomotu yaamukhaani", ni yaakunyariwe ni mikoroxikopiixita mmosa woona mukhalelo wa ekoritiisa.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: eseelula ti mpantta wooreerela wa khula pinaatamu, ni mirutthu sootheene sinipakiwa mwaha wa iseelula soovirikana.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Iseelula ti sootepexa oreerela ni ikiriitika wa musomo wa ekumi oniitthaneliwa "maluku ooreerela a ekumi".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Esixiteema nerivoosu enikhapelela homeostase oveleelihaka imumulelo nerivoosu mwiirutthuni wiira ohiye mwaattelo wa ephome ottharaka voohivirikanihiwa.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Wa impuulusu iyo nerivoosu sinimalela oveleelihiwa wa mananna oowaakuveya erutthu yootheene, ekhanle ti enikhaliherya wiikhapelelana wa khula ekaruma yoowoopopiha.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Sapakeya vale sinniphiya mmapuroni makhaani, ni mulikanyiho wa mikumelelo sikinaku soowoopopiha, masi sinimalela opwanyulaka sootheene siri mphironi mwaya.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Anamatthikela owaani aniikitthasa miri, anikumihasa ithaapwa sa itthu soopakiw ni anivonyerasa ikaaro musulu. Anamatthikela owaani ootepexa waaluwa, aniphiyererya 2% wa omaliherya, anivira iwoora tthaaru.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Amwanamukhaya oowoopihaxa anilipeleleya ni ipheyo sinirowa mpakha 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Apinaatamu anooruwerya ni anirumeela ilenti wiira yinnuwihe miyaakha ni miyaakha sene.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Wa siiso, itelexikoopiyu soopaceryasa ekeekhayi saapakiwe Weewuroopa wuumaleloni wa miyaakha imiya XVI.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Itelexikoopiyu iyo saarumeela mwiiwanano wa ilenti piili wiira sipakiwe itthu soorakamela wi sikhaleke ntoko suulupale ni sookhuveelexa.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ekanansiya ni ekowiiximu khisinkhalakhala simalamalaka, ni ti sa ephattu sa ekoperasawu, yakhala atthu oowaatta sinaareerela, anikhala oxintta muhina mwa okathi vakhaani avaraka wa mananna a ekoyiiximu.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Ninlipela wa atthu anceene asuweleke wiira muthanlelo aya wootepexa oreera ni woorakamela ti ovara hoothe ni atthu.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Atthu anceene aniloherya nihiku apinaatamu anirowaaya weetta ekwaha ya etheneeri ekinaku wiira yawelo ilimwenku sikinaku, akinaku anniikoha ti exeeni ekhanle ota wu, akinaku anikhupali wiira ari maaliyeniixena wala akinaku makhalelo makinaku a ekumi animalela okhalaka ipalaneeta sikinaku.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Masi eyo, yakhumelela nihiku ti nno, emmalela ohikhumelela okathi woowaatta. Ittheneeri siniphwanyaneya soomwaramwareya ni murakamelo wa itirilyawu sa ikiloometuru wa ittheneeri siri "vakhiviru".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Nihiku nno, mapixineetu ayu animalela okhala epalaneeta exitaratereexitere, akohanasaka wa amusi aya maarakayiku akhwaale.
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Inama sinipakiwa ni iseelula soovirikana. Awo anilya itthu soovirikna ni anihela mmirimani mwaya. Mpantta muulupalewa inama sinniwerya weetta veekhaaya.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.
