text: Inama paahi sirina ottooporo (masi kahiyo inama sootheene sirina ottooporo; maasi makumi, kharina ottooporo).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Inama sinniphwanyaneya epalaneeta yootheene. Iyo sinnithipa etthaya, sinnikatelela mphareya ni sinnivava musulu.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Eseelula ti mpantta mwaamukhaani a mukhalelo ni enivariha muteko irutthu sa inama sinimumula.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Eseelula enikhuma muhina mwa nlove latiina cella, enihimya ekoomotu yaamukhaani.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Nyuwo mwaweha itthu sinimumula ni ekaruma enaasimiwa emikoroxikoopiyu, munooweha wiira sirina mikhalelo micikhaani kwataraatu wala apoola.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, piyooloku a winkalateera, ohoona ikwataraatu icikhaani mwa ikoritiisa ni emikorixikoopiyu.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Awo yaakhala ntoko kaamara. Owo waari mutthu oopacerya oweha iseelu sinikhwa.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Ilementu ni ikompooxitu sinimalela ovirikana mukhalelo aya voohivirikaniha ennakhala etthu emosa.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitoroxeeniyu nkhama kaaxi nlelo orina ekhalelo ya nitoroxeeniyu a maasyeene. Mukhalelo wa masi ti ootepexa otikanela, masi imoleekula nlelo simosaru.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Maasi muthoonyero mukinaku. Kompooxitu wa maasi onipakiwa ni aatomu ayili a itoroxeeniyu ni aatomu a okisixeeniyu.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Orina mukhalelo mmosaru molekulaare, kaaxi, liikitu wala sootiyu.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Onasuweleyaru wiira mukhalelo aya oowooneya onimalela ovirikana, mukhalelo awe kiimiku nlelo mmosaru.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Okathi etthu eniphwanyaneya eriyari ahu, ni onniphwanya itthu sootheene ninvaraahu, enakhalakaru etthu yoorika osuwela.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Okathi waasomiwe ni anaxikola a itiini, filosoofiku ni siyentiifiku wa miyaakha sivinre.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Okathi nisuwenle okhala mpantta wa mikhumelelo soovira, sa ohoolo ni sa niinaano wa soovira.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Okathi ti, tho, nkhama ninlikanihaahu  mupiseryo (ekompirimentu)  sa ipheyo.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Nyuwo pooti omarakhari ekwaha ya okathi ya veekhaany moonaka mutthikeleyo wa mukhumelelo siikiliku. Mkhumelelo siikiliku ti etthu enikhumelela vakinaku ni vakinaku tho ni vootthikeleya.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Ikomputatoore sa olelo sinirumeeliwa wi sivirikaniheke ilatarato ni iviitiyu.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Mihakalalo sootepexa oreera sinimalela winnuwihiwa ni ikomputatoore, ni muthinto owo wa muhakalalo onootepa ovira orumeeliwaka mutelevisawuni ni nfiilimeni.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Ikwaha sikinaku, esipo enikaravariwa ni maakina ooreeriha itthu wiira aporosesari ni akompilari masu.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Wa okathi munceene, wuuvirani wa miyaakha imiya XIX ni XX, waanikhupaliwa wiira attu oopacerya yaakhala Onoova Selantiya yaari atthu a Mawori, yaasaya axinuuni aalupale yeetthaneliwa moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Eteyoriya nto evaha miruku wiira atthu a Mawori yaakhuma Opolineesiya wa eforota yuulupale ni aphiya Onoova Selantiya wa Moriyoori, apakaka muttetthe wa muruweryo wa soolya.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Wa  sootheene, miyooniheryo sa niinaano sinihimya wiira Moriyoori, naari nikhuru na Mawori a ekontinente yaakhumanse aya ya Onoova Selantiya arowaka  Iyiilya Chatham, yinnuwihaka ewahala aya yoohilikana ni pasiifika.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Naahikhala tho nihimo nikinaku muhina mwa  Iyiilya Chatham, yaari maoris yaakhumanse Onoova Selantiya.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Awo yeetthanelana Moriyoori, saahikhala minyakunyaku ni wuumaleloni, Moriyoori, aniivakasiwa.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Atthu yeerenle mpantta wa miyaakha miyaakha sene aanikhaliherya owehaweha mireerelo sahu ni ipaxawu, okathi nin'hoolelaahu mananna oosuwanyeya a mikacamiho, mpakha ni miyoolowelo.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Okathi ninwiiwaahu atthu asuwelihaka ihantisi saya, sa amusi aya ni sa milokiheryo, ninkhala osuwela wa itthu sivinre okhalayini ni atthu ale oosuwelaxiwa oruuhela ewahala ya mulokiheryo yooreera ni yoonanara.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Onasuweleyakaru wiira musuwelo wa ihantisi sa mutthu mmosa khasiniira mpantta wa musuweliho wa ewahala, masi sinnaakhaliherya atthu asuwela ti woowi siniphwanyaneyaaya muhntisini wa mulokiheryo.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Okathi oniwehawehiwaaya mireerelo ni anikhala oowiiwelela miyoolowelo, atthu ni nikhuru na atthu anikhalela annisophela, masi wa mananna oowiixerya, ihisapo, emisawu ni ikuru motiriixi sa mulokiheryo.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Wa siisa, wuupuwela vakinaku wa myaha sivinre sa ekomporotamentu empereyentetoore ni mireerelo sookhumelela  saahaathupererya atthu otthuniheryana mivirikana sipheya ni iphiro sipheya soowaaroohela okerexa wa mmuttettheni.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Wa ithale iyo sa miphiyereryo sooreerela saahivukula moovelo wa muvirikano, wa okathi yoowo, sinnikhumelela mithetemano sooreera ni muttittimiho wa mvirikano wa ohoolo.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Mapatarawu a muupuwelo konverexenti ti eteekinika sa mmaliheryo sa milattu sintakanxerya miruku soovirikana wala mapuro oophwanya esolusawu.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Mphaveleyo wa muupuwelo owo ti mwaakuvelo, elooxika ni muvarelo wooreera, ohiya mithoonyiheryo sa mikhumelelo, ereyapilikasawu ya iteekinika siniphwanyaneya ni muvenxeryo wa mihupi.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Eniiriha yootepexa oreerela ya muupuwelo owo ti: mwaakhulelo wooreera ori mmosa paahi. Nyuwo munuupuwela paahi wa myaakhulelo miili paahi, wala, yoolikaniheya ni yoohilikaniheya.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Muthinto owo a muupuwelo oniira mpantta ni myeettiheryo sootthareleleya wala siyentiifiku.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Atthu arina muthinto owo wa muupuwelo, aakhalana muupuwelo wooreerela, aakhalana owerya wa wuupuwelela mittharelelo, omaliha milattu ni ovara ni iteexiti siyentiifiku.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Apinaatamu itthu kamosa kamosa siniisa osuwelaxa nkhama osomo wa itthu iye anuupuwela akinaku.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Eyo enithoonyiherya wiira  nihaana owerya wuupuwele ele apinaatamu akinaku anuupuwelelaaya, aniphavelaaya, anikhupalyaaya, anisuwelaaya wala anitthunaaya.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Wa miweryelo iyo, osuwela aniphavelaaya atthu akinaku ti etthu yooreera. Eyo ti etthu eniiriha nikhalanaka owerya oreeriha iye sinikhumelela wa khula nihiku.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Sintoko, nyuwo mwaamoonale mutthu opwexaka ixanela sa ekaaro, kinoona wiira nyuwo mwaakela wooniherya nto wiira owo oniphavela wiiya ekaaro ya mutthu mukinaku.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Owo waamukela ophavela ophukiwa wa mananna ooreerela wakhala wiira saaruumuriheya ixaavi ya ekaaro ni waaphavela wiiya ekaaro awe.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: RM onikhapelela mukhumelelo onooneya onaasimeliwa resonansiya makineetika nukeleyaari (RMN), wooneneliwe miyaakha sa 1930  ni Felix Bloch (waavara Wuuniverisitaati wa Stanford) ni Edward Purcell (Univerisitaati wa Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Eresonansiya eyo, ekampu makineetiku ni mawimpi a raatiyu sinnaatthuniherya aatomu okumiherya ikhomo sikhaani sa raatiyu.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Raymond Damadian, meetiku ni siyentiixita namathokoca, waahoonenela epaasi ya murumeeliyo wa eresonansiya makineetika nkhama ekaruma ya tiyakonooxitiku meetiku, mwaakha wa 1970.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Nooviriha miyaakha mixexe ola waahivahiwaeantenti, ekhanle ti yaari epatenti yoopacerya moolumwenkuni vanipuroni wa eresonansiya makineetika.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mwaakha wa 1977, meetiku Damadian waahimmaliherya o ommontari ixitatoore a eresonansiya makineetika a "erutthu yoomalela", yoowo aamwaasimenlaawe okhala "intomaavele".
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Muvaanelo asinkoroona onitthuniherya okathi woowuupuwela ni wuupuwelela mananna oomwaakhula mukinaku.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Eyo enaakhaliherya anaxikola wiira avareke miteko okathi ayaru ni okhapelela mweettelo wa mihupi sooleeliheriwa.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ohiya tho vo, ni mukhaliheryo wa muteko oowaakuveya, mikottiheryo muhina mwa okhathi sinootepa sivukuwaka. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Murumeelo wa interineeti ya World Wide Web (reeti mntiyaali a ikomptatoore) onnaakhaliherya anaxikola ophwanya mihpi wa khula okathi.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Ni anaxikola pooti waaveleeliherya makoho maxiturutoore wa khla okathi wa nihiku ni olipelela myaakhlelo wa mananna oowaakveya, ohiya olipelela mpakha okathi onikelaaya okumanela tho.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Mileeliheryo sa niinaano sa maxuttelo sinnihiya ottuli muruku oowooniheriwa. Kharivo mananna mamosa ooxutta.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Veekeekhayi, khiivo etthu yooreera paahi wiira exuttiwe. Muxuttelo onikhumelela okathi wa mutteho wa naxikola ni muxutto oothoonyiheriwa.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Muxuttelo ahu wa niinaano muhina mwa TV ootheene  onixuttiha itthu, nkhama mpakeke-mwaaneene ni anivaha mihupi, annooniherya ekhomo eyo.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Oowaatta wa hiyo naarwa nimoonaka porokaraama televisiivu onnileeliherya wa mweettelo wala muxuttelo  yoowo nihinkelaahu okhalela wala muxuttelo nihinkelaahu ovarela muteko.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Hiyo khininkhalakhala nilokihaka ekaaro, ninookela oteka efonti muhina mwa munikokoroni mwahu, wala weetta ekwaha nikelaka Operu wiira nisuwele vavithiwe amusi ahu, nnakhala olokiha empa ya namwaattamanana ahu.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Ni mukhaliheryo wa ilikasawu wa ekaau ya efiipara ootika evirihiwe mphareya ekelihiwaka Weewurooa ni sateeliti a epanta laarika, Korowelantiya khoreere okonekitareya ni 93% sa atthu anirumeela Interineeti.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Oteeli awe wala manfitiriyawu awe (wa mwaha wa mweemelelo wala empa ya naveekhaawe) onimalela okhalana interineeti yoohikhala efiiyu wala ekomputatoore yoolpanyihiwa interineeti, ni munikhaliwa mootheene mookhalana assentamentos wala nipuru na interineeti noohikhalana efiiyu yoolikana.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Sintoko valavuliwaaya ottuli, onasuweleyakaru wiira nsina "Esquimó"  nlelo ninvira naakhuleliwaka mukano EUA, nno ninooniwa okhala noowaaveeha atthu anceene a waaritiku ahinikhala mukano wa EUA, otepexa Okanata.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Muneyiwakaru nlove ninlavuliwa ni axineene a Okorowelantiya, olavuliwa waya nihaana wiinaneliwa ni atthu anikhuma ilapo sikinaku.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Axineene anikhala Okorowelantiya aniitthanana yaaworu ohikhala atthu Okanata ni Kalaalleq (Kalaallit no plural), korowelanteexi Okorowelantiya.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Ikhirini, ni ohisiveliwa ni atthu a ilapo sikinaku, khasinsuweliwa Okorowelantiya. Nnakhala mpooma, khasikhanle "mapuro oowoopiha".
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Okathi wooriirya ti okathi onooniwa okhala oowoopiha eekeekhayi muhina mwa atthu ale ahiniilokiherya anikelaaya ohoolela.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Mwamuxukurya Korowelantiya okathi ole wooriirya (vooneyaka wiira, wakelelexa omukoni, oriirya onootepa), vannireerela okuxa ikuwo sooreerela sooviha.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Mahiku oopixa wiila okathi ole wooviha onimalela oruuhela mikacamiho soorupa oratteene ni myaha sa ekumi sootakaneela.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Okathi wooviha, mukhalane mukhapelelo wa apwilimwithi oomukoni. Ahinavaheru iretta, awo pooti onyoonyiha.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Vanasuweleyakaru wiira ekonomiya ya Osawu Faransiixiku okhala mapuro oowaaruuhela maturiixita a ekalaase muntiyaali, ekonomiya aya ti yoovirikanihiwa.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Mapuro ooreerela aniphwanyiha muteko ti: miteko porofisiyonaali, kuveerunu, finanseeru, komeerisiyu ni turiiximu.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Murweelo awe woohipisa musiponi, ifiilimeni, literatuurura ni ewahala ya atthu yookhaliherya epooma ni imaaruku saya osuweliwa olumwenku wootheene.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Sawu Faransiixiku ohinnuwiha infaraxiturutuura turiixitika yuulupale yookhalana mooteeli oovirikana, irexitawuranti ni mapuro amuthukumano ooreerexa.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Sawu Faransiixiku ti tho mapuro ootepexa oreera a mulaponi muhina mwa miyaapeelo sa mithanlelo sikinaku sa waasiya: eyoolya koreyaana, tayilanteesa, intiyaana ni xaponeesa.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Weetta ekwaha okelaka Walt Disney World ti etthu nkhama eperikirinasawu muhina mwa amusi anceene a waameerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Muxukuryo "tiipika"onitthuniherya okhuruwa Wayerepoorutu Interinasiyonal ya Orlando, orowa ni ekaaro mpakha wooteeli Disney onipuroni, okela oviriha esumana emosa woohikhuma muhina mwa Disney, ni otthikela owaani.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Sookhala mivirikano soowaatta, masi owo onivira otthikelaka okhala ole atthu anceene anilavula "orowa wa Disney".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Wa inkereesu soowaatta situmihiwe online muhina mwa isayite sa leyilawu, nkhama  eBay wala Craigslist, ti veekeekhayi, inkereesu sa mahiku oowaatta ni ipaarikhi soowaatta sirumeeliwe.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Muteko ola onakhalakaru aatthu anceene, owo onnikottihiwa ni Disney: inkereesu iyo khasinvahananiwa.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Ohaana okhala mutthuniheryo wiira orupe wa khula nipuro nimphwanyaneya muhina mwa Grand Canyon.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Ilisensa ti soolimitareya wiira okhapeleliwe  cânion. Iyo sinikhala voohimuteko wuupaceryani wa mweeri, miyeeri mixexe ohinatthi ophiya mweeri woopaceriwa.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Siiso, elisensa ya epayisaxe ya khula nihiku noopacerya mweeri wa mayiyu enirowa okhumelela nihiku na 1° wa Xaneeru.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Nlaka wa mapuro oosuwelaxiwa, nkhama Bright Angel Campground, onikhala mpantta wa  Ohantom Ranch, onikhala osariwa nihiku noopacerya nintthukuliwaaya wa ireseeriva.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Ookhala mwaattelo woomalela wa ilisensa soopwehiwa sa mivekelo sa mukelelo soohinamwaneene sittharihiwaka murweelo wa atthu.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Orowa ni ekaaro Waafirika wa Okuusini ti mananna ooreera oweha mireerelo sa epooma ni ophwanya mapuro ota wa iroota triixitika sa atthu ootheene.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Eyo pooti opakiwa ni ekaaro yooreerela ni muupuwelo wa mwiinanelo, masi 4x4 ti wootepexa woopereriwa ni mapuro manceene ti ale anireerela orowa ni ekaaro nkhama 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Ohaana wuupuwela wiira, Aafirika Awuxitaraale onakhalakaru saana, khasihiyo ilapo sootheene soowaattamela siri saana.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Mirumeelo saya, irekisiitu ni ihisapo sa viixitu sinivirikana elapo ni elapo, ni awo tho anaafetariwa tho ni ilapo aya weyiwo nyuwo munikhumaanyu.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Khula elapo ehaana malamulo aya anilakela wa khula etthu enikhumelela voowaakveya sinikhala mmukukuttani.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Epooma ya Vitooriya Falls eniphwanyaneya mpantta wa oweexite wa Osimpwaapwe, ovikanaka mwiinano wa Livingstone, Osampiya, woohirakamela elapo ya Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Epooma eniphwanyaneya ottuli wa ikataraata, ti iya sinaaruhela atthu mapuro ala, ohiya tho eyo nipuro nna turiixitika ninnivaha mirukuneyo ni maturiixita oovirikana ni ooreera othweelana.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Okathi wa ipula (okhuma noovempuru mpakha maarusu), mwaattelo wa maasi onirowa okhala woosuwanyeya ni muhononelo aya onookela waatta.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Veekeekhayi nyuwo munookela wiinaaniha mwakhala wiira munoolapuwa eponti wala weetta mukerekhere mwa itirilya waattamela mweemenle maasi.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Wa mpantta mukinaku, ti vamphavelexeya okhala wiira mwinnuwelo wa maasi toorakamexa ovikana moonelo aya weekeekhayi wa Ikataraata onirowa oriipela - mwaha wa maasi ootheene.
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Etumpa yaTutancâmon (KV62). KV62 ti etumpa yoosuwelaxiwa Ovaale, mukhumelelo wa mooneneliyo wa mahitthi a ekeekhayi oohihononeya a namittompe mwene  Howard Carter wa 1922.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Siiso, khivanireera oxukurya mahiye mahiye a Tutancâmon mwa mulikaniho ni mahiye manceene eekeekhayi, okhala wiira khareere oyeva ni etekorasawu aya yaamukhaani.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Ole onitthuna owoona muhononiwaawe muumiya okathi waakumihiwaawe mukaxawuni onookela oriipiwa murima, okhala wiira onooneya muru ni makhata awe paahi.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Mireerelo soowaatta sa mmahiye khasinimphwanya tho owo, masi  sirowaniwe Omusewu Exiipisiyu, Okayiru.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Anamaxukurya ni okathi vakhaani waamureera aronweene oviriha okathi aya mpantta mukinaku.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km a osutuweexiti wa Siem Reap. Etempulu ela vasulu wa ekolina etekiwe wuumaleloni wa miyaakha imiya 9, okathi wa mwene Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Atimoxifeera oohikhalana mmwaleelo wa etempulu ni mooneeleyo wa muru  Tonle Sap anipaka muwelelelo wa ekolina ookhala mwaaleyiwe.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Muxukuryo wa nipuro nno enimalela okhala etthu yooreera yoowiiwananiwa ni mweettakaso wa ekalawa mpakha omuro.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass ti onnireerela wiira mutthu okele mutempuluni, weeso muhiliyale omuruuha pasapooriti anyu waarowaka Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Xerusaleemu ekapitaali yuulupale ya epooma ya Ixirayeeli, onasuweleyakaru wiira ilapo sikinaku ni ilapo sa wiiraana khasinikupali wiira ekapitaali ya Wiixirayeeli.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Epooma yookhaliya ya Ikolina sa Oxuteyiya yookhalana ehantisi yooreera eniphiyererya miyaakha miyaakha sene.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Epooma eyo sakaraata wa itiini tthaaru monoteyiixita - xutayiku, kirixitiyaniiximu ni ixilamiiximu - ni eriyari ya erooho yoowaarya, etiini ni ewaha.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Mwaha wa muttittimiho wa itiini sa opooma, ni mapuro makinaku a Epooma Yookhalayi, Xerusaleemu ti mapuro kamosa kamosa aniphiyexa maturiixitiku elapo ya Wiixirayeeli.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Xerusaleemu khoreerane mapuro a ihantisi, arikiyolooxiku ni iwahala, ohiya shopping centers, ikafe ni irexitawuranti sooreerela ni yoohikhalana mathala.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekwatoore onikhanyererya wiira atthu a Okuupa ahaana waakhela ewarakha - ya mulattulo ahinatthi okela mulaponi ni mukhaliheryo wa ayeropoorutuinterinasiyonaali wala ikhomo sikinaku samukelelo sa mmwiinanoni.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Ewarakha eyo ehaana waakhuleliwa ni Minixiteeriyu wa Mipatthanano sa Ota wa Ekwatoore, otharihela irekisiitu saya.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Makhalelo ala anipakiwa wiira avaheke mwaattelo wa atthu anikela muhina mwa ilapo iya piili.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Atthu a Okuupa ari anamawarelo a Green Cards maamerikaanu ahaana omuxukurya konsulaatu ekwatoriyaanu wiira aleviwe muhina mwa mikhanyereryo iyo.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Pasapooriti ayu ohaana okhalana ekumi ya miyeeri 6 wa mahiku ale aneettaanyu ekwaha. Enniphaveleya  okhala epasaci yoorowana ni yootthikana wiira  otthoonyiherye okathi awo okhanlaawe.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ekwaha yooweettiwa enireerela okhalela ni atthu anceene, nto nyuwo mwakhala veekhiinyu wala ni mpatthani mmosa, ohaana ophavela waasuwela atthu akinaku ni opaka nikhuru na atthu axexe wala athanu ni mmosa wiira akhalana ehisapo yootepexa okhweya wa khula mutthu.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Siiso, eyo khiyaareerela okhala etthu yookacamiha, okhala wiira okathi munceene maturiixita anamwiixeettela wiira amuhela tiiseli mukaaroni.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Wa ekeekhayi, onikhala nto ophavela waathepya atthu,  yaakhupalihaka wiira ahaana oliva tho.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Vasulu wa ekhomo ya omukoni wa Machu Picchu enikhala mwaako ola muulupale, okathi mukinaku onikhala epaanu ya efuntu wa ilatarato sinceene sa iruwiina.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Muwelelo muulupale ni wootikiniha, ti vo onimalela okhala oowoopopiha waawehiwaka vathi, masi ole ori mukumi onniwerya weetta iminuutu soophiyeryaka 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Ixikatta sa maluku ooheliwa muniviriwa, ni mipantta soowinnuwexa, ikaapu sa aasu sinnivaha ikorimaawu soovarela.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Eyo eheliwe, olipeleleke okhulumuwa toko, ni ohaana okhalana ephoole mapuro ookhuruwela, otepexa wanaana vale, okhala wiira enimalela okhala etthu yoowoopihaxa.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Vanniphaveleya olapuwa nikhuku vasulu va mwaako. Nno ti nookhuveya ni noophunyeya mutthu waphavela okela.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Ti vooreera owehaweha oratteene mapuru awo ni mukhalelo wa inama sa Ikalapaaku sa mwaatiya, sintoko vaapankaawe Charles Darwin mwaakha wa 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Myaatiya soophiyeryaka 60 sintthentta mmaasini mwa Ikalapaaku, ni mwinnuwelo oowaalovola atthu oophiyeryaka okhuma 8 mpakha 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Omwaatteloni wa atthu annisuka nipuro naya nihinatthi ophiya nihiku (okhala wiira myaatiya sinikhala osareyiwa).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Mukhupaliki wiira mulipa onikela waakuxa atthu ti oosuwelaxa Ikalapaaku ni onnisuwela mwaatelo wa myaatiya.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Nsa, nyuwo munookela ophwanya mwaatiya oowoosivelaxani wala oohaatteliwa.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Maxipanyooli ahinatthi ophiya, miyaakha imiya 16, omukoni wa Oxile waakhapeleliwa ni  incas. Okathi ola, mintiixena arawukaanu (mapuches) yaakhala eriyari ni okuusini wa Oxile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuches yaarisi wa makhuru kamosa kamosa ookhiserya a mintiixena a waameerika yeyirumeela, awo khiyaalavulasa nttaava na oxipaanya, mpakha okhumelela moopowelo wa Oxile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Onasuweleyakaru wiira Xile waahilamula moopowelo mwaakha wa 1810 (eriyari ya ikhotto napoleyoonika saamuhin'ye Exipaanya voohikuveerunu senteraali wa miyaakha soowaatta), vitooriya woolakeliwa ni  Exipaanya waaphiyereriwe paahi mwaakha wa 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Erepuupilika Tominikaana (ni ekunya wala ni exipanyooli) ti elapo ya karipi enikupari emetaati ya Eyiilya ya Osawu Tominku, yeeyo enikawanyeya ni Hayiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ohiya iphareya sa mithaaka sootteela ni mapuro a miyaako, elapo yookhalana epooma ewuropeyiya yootepexa okhala yookhalayi sa waameerika, wa niinaano eniira mpantta wa Santu Tominku.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Eyiilya yaakhaliwa ekwaha yoopacerya ni matayiyanu ni makaripi. Makaripi yaari atthu yaalavula nttaava na aruwaaki yaaphiyanse okathi wa 10.000 AC.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Noovira miyaakha vakhaani anaphiyasa maxipoloratoore a weewuroopa, atthu a Otayiyaanu yaahivukuwa mwaha wa anamaphepyasa maxipanyooli.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Sintoko vanihimyaawe  Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tarataatu wa Intiya), okhuma 1492 mpakha  1498, anamaphepyasa maxipanyooli yaahiwiivakasa Matayiyaanu oophiyeryaka 100.000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Nipuro nna nitekiwe nkhama atiriyu wa konventu wa miyaakha imiya 17, nenno Etempulu ya San Diego etifiisiyu emosa ekhanle.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Niinaano eri nkhama eparasa pirinsipaali, weyiwo oniisa otthekuliwa, okathi wa othana ni wa ohiyu.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Khasireere irexitawurante sinirukurerya exariti, ni okathi wa othana ni ohiyu, annikhumelelaka akonseerutu ahiniliviwa okasepu senteraali.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (mphito wa epeecu). Mapithela mayili oohiyana ni isentiimeturu 69 ti elaare ya elenta yookhalayi ya mphento.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Wa myaakakhano sikinaku, anamwane akinaku aaleeliheriwa ehantisi.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Eyiilya ya Bowen ti nipuro noosuwelaxiwa nooreerela ottekula othana wala wuumaleloni wa esumana, nivahaka myeettekeso sa kayiyaaki, myeettelo, soothuma, irexitawuranti ni itthu sikinaku.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Muttetthe owo woolikana onimalela ophwanyiwaka mukano wa  Howe Sound, yaattamela mukano wa Vancouver, ni wookhalana aseesu ookweeheriwa wa itaakisi sammaasini soowaaxentariwa sinikhuma Granville Island, eriyari ya Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Wa alipa ale sinaasivela miteko sa mpantta wa ota, yeettaka vakoretoore Sea to Sky ti wookhanyereriwa.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1:30 min. ni ekaaro ya Vancouver) ti ewiitho, yootepexa osiveliwa ni atthu mwaha wa Ilimpiiyata sa Muriirelo wa 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Okathi wooriirya, muhakalaleke wa mireerelo sikinaku sa ipiixita sa esqui sa Waameerika wa Omukoni ni, okathi wooviha, otteheke omweettiha mucinka mmwaako.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ilisensa sihaana ovekeliwa mahiku ahiphin'ye. Nyuwo muhaana otthuniheriwa wiira mweettakase Osirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Ohiya mapuro oorupa, Osirena nipuro nimosa nirina epooxitu ya anamalipelela a etakhwa enivaha nipuro noorupa ni voorupa ni iyoolya sooviha. La Leona, San Pedrillo ni Los Patos sinnivaha nipuro nookhala, masi khisinivaha yoolya.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Pooti okhalana ilisensa sa opaarikhi okumihaka Exitasawu ya Etakhwa mukano wa  Puerto Jiménez, masi awo khanitthuna ikaratawu sa ekereetitu.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Muteko wa Opaarikhi (MINAE)  khonivaha mitthuniheryo ohaleelaka mweeri mmosa wa muphiyelo oowuupuweleliwa.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol onnivaha muteko wa muxukeryo wa ehisapo ya itoolare 30 wala 10 wa myeettakaso sa nihiku nimosa; mihupi sikinaku siniphwanyaneya epaaxina ya Korokovaatu.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Iyiilya Cook ti elapo insulare yoohikhalana mikanyamiho ni yoopatthanana ni Noova Silantiya, eniphwanyaneya Opolineesiya, eriyari ya Pasiifiku a Okuusini.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Arikipeelaku ookhalana iyiilya 15 soomwaramwareya wa imilyawu 2,2 sa ikiloometuru kwataraatu sa oseyaanu.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ni fuusu oraariyu wa mmosaru ni wa Havaí, okathi mukinaku iyiilya  sinooniwa okhala nkhama  "Havaí vathi wu".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ohiya ovukuwa, kiniwupuwela anamaxkrya ookhalayi a Havaí  exitatt ya Exitaat ehinatthi, oteeli ootheene turiixitiku aalupale ni minnuwelo sikinaku.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Iyiilya Cook khisirina nnakha epooma, masi ti sookhala iyiilya 15 soovirikana. Sootepexa osuweliwa ti Rarotonga ni Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Mahiku a olelo, wa ilapo soowinnuwihana, muvahu wa mapuro ookhala ni ekafe ya voosiisuya yooreerela epakiwe okhala etthu nkhama aariti.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Osulu, mapuro ookhala B&Bs anikhalana  itthu piili: ekhaama ni ekafe ya voosiisu.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Vamutikiniho vo, mootepexa oyeya uhina mwa exitapelesimentu iya, sinniphwanyaneya tho itthu sootepexa okhala sa musurukhu sintoko ekhaama, yoopakiwa ni matata wala ekhaama yookhalayi.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Ekafe ya voosiisu enimalela okhalana itthu soosiva siva sa muttetthe yoowo wala iparatho siri soosuwanyeya sa anfitiriyawu.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Mwaha ola onimalela okhala muhina mwa etifiisiyu yookhalayi ya ihantisi ni ikaruma soowuuluvalasa, ixariti ni sooreerihiwa oratteene ni ipisina sinirapiwa ni atthu.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Okela mukaaroni mwanyu ni eweetta ekwaha yuulupale muruku wootepexa ohakalaleya.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ovirikana ikaaro suulupale, nyuwo moolimalela weettiha ekaaro aya ni unnisuwela miinanelo saya.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Oteka iparaka mapuro ale oohaatteliwa wala wa khula muthinto wa epooma onimalela waaruuhela atthu anceene wahaaphavelaawe.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Wuumaliheryani, weettiha ekaaro anyu ti mananna ooweetta ekwaha ya vathi yooreera, masi yoorikexa, waakampari yeekhiinyu".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Orupa mukaarooni vanniiraneya nyuwo mwakhalana minivan, SUV, sedã, wala orupela ikhukulu soothetemana.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Oteeli sikinaku sirina eransa ya okathi wa ewooro sa iferoviya sa vapoore ni taransatalantiku; ehinatthi Ekhotto Muntiyaali ya Nayili, muhina mwa miyaakha imiya 19 wala wuupaceryani wa miyaakha imiya 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Oteeli iya ti mmwe yaamakaaya mathaaciri ni anamasuwelaxiwa ni atthu ootheene ni masu manceene yaahikhalana mulipelelo ni irexitawurante sooreera ni ekumi yoohiyu yoomaaleleya.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Ikaruma soovira nkhamu, sinnithowela mihakalalo sooreera, ni muuluvalelo wooreera, ni tho oniira mpantta wa eperisonalitaati.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Onasuwanyeyaru wiira ti sa mwaneene, okathi mukinaku annimakasa makhulupale a kuveerunu ni anamaxukurya akinaku.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Namweetta mukwaha ookhalana musurukhu munceene ohaana osuwela wiira owo aneettakasa moolumwenkuni, wiihelaka eriyari ni wa mukhalo wa mahiku anceene mooteeli mmo.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Reeti mmosa wa interikampiyu a mwaakhelelo wa aletto ti mulokiheryo onaalupanyiha anamaxukurya a mapuro wa ipooma iye awo yootonlaaya.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Wiira wiire mpantta wa muthinto owo wa reeti, ohaana omuttiyattiya forumulaariyu on-line; onasuwanyeyaru wiira areeti akinaku annivaha wala annikhanyererya muwehaweho woomalela.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Nto ennivahiwa eliixita ya manfitiriyawu eniphwanyaneya wa mananna a impereesa wala online, okathi mukinaku ni ireferensiya ni miwehaweho wa anamaxukurya akinaku.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing epakiwe mweeri wa Xaneeru wa mwaakha wa 2004, noovira okathi wa porokaramatoore wa ikomputatoore  Casey Fenton noopwanya ntteeke nookhweya ehisapo orowaka Wiixilantiya, voohikhalana nipuru nookela okhala.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Owo aahaaveleeliha e-mail anaxikola a univerisitaati ya weyiwo ni ola waahaakhelela mammeru manceene yaamuvaha nipuro nookela okhala voohiliva.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Mooteeli ti aanamittompe - muletto onikhala impa sooviriha miyaakha 20 - masi tho nyuwo pooti waaphwanya anamweetta ekwaha ootepexa wuuluvala.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Amusi arina anamwane acikhaani khanaattela, masi mapuro ale aniliviwa makinaku annaatthuniherya wiira awo akhaleke mapuro oohaatteliwa.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Epooma ya Opequim, Oxiina, enirowa okhala nipuro namwiiraneyo  wa amphira Olimpiku okathi ole wooriirya wa 2022, ekhanle ti enikela wiiriha ekhalaka epooma yoopacerya owaakhelela amphira Olimpiku okathi wooviha ni wooriirya.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pequim enirowa okhala eseeti ya iserimooniya sa mutthukulelo ni muwalelo ni mikhumelelo sa exeelu yookhuneeliwa.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Mikhumelelo sikinaku sa esqui sikhumelenle omukanoni wa esqui wa Taizicheng, mwa Zhangjiakou, waattamela 220 km  (imiilya soophiyeryaka 140) wa Opequim.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Itempulu sinceene sookhalana ncampo wuumaleloni wa mwaakha nimpacerya mweeri wa Noovempuru ni nimmala eriyari ya mweeri wa mayiyu, ninttharihela ekalentaariyu ya mwaakha ya khula etempulu.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Macampo oowaatta a etempulu ti aniira mpantta wa nihiku wa etempulu wala nihiku na etivintaati peresitenti wala khula mukhumelelo mukinaku wooreerela oniira mpantta ni etempulu.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Macampo a itempulu sa Kerala  ti sootepexa oreera, ni iporosisawu sooreeriha itthepo sooreerela, orikweexitara mutempuluni ni macampo makinaku.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Efeyira Muntiyaali (yoosuwelaxiwa ni nsina na Exiposisawu Muntiyaali wala Eexipo) ti ncampo interinasiyonaali nuulupale na aariti ni isiyensiya.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Ilapo sinikhalela sookhalana mithoonyeryo aritiixitika ni sa mixuttiho muhina mwa ipavilyawu nasiyonaali ni mphiyereryo wa wooniherya myaha muntiyaali wala ewahala ni ehantisi ya elapo.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Ixiposisawu Oritikuluturaali ti macampo anooniherya musuwelo aya wa ithutu, ixariti sa miri ni sootheene iye siniira mpantta ni miri.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Onasuwanyeyakaru wiira sinimalela okhumelela wa khula mwaakha (sakhalaru ilapo soovirikana), veekeekhayi khavaniiraneya.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Mikhuelelo iya sinnipisa miyeeri soophiyeryaka miraru mpakha mithanu ni mmosa ni  sinipakiwa mapuro ookhalana mwinnuwelo oophiyeryaka ikitaare 50.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Khareere mananna oovirikana a ifiilime anirumeeliwa ni wuuvirani wa okathi. Efiilime ya 35 mm ya muttharelo aya (yoohiloka ya 36 wa 24mm) ti mukhalelo woosuwelaxiwa.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Okathi wootheene, owo ti ootepexa okhweya otthikeliwa nyuwo mwaahikhalane tho  yoowoona ni ennitthuniherya mulokiheryo woolikana ni DSLR  wa niinaano.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Akaamara akinaku a efiilime ya mwinnuwelo meetiyu sinirumeela ekhalelo ya 6 wa 6 cm, masi yoophaveleya tho muhilokelo aya wa 56 ni 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Eyo ooniherya mulokiheryo wa oniphiyererya ivaara xexe suulupale ovirikana wa ele yoohiloka ni miphimelo sa 35 mm (3136 mm2 wa 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Ohoolela ikumi sa inama sa mutakhwani ti etthu yootepexa waakacamiha anamalatha elatarato  ni aniphavela mwiiwanano wa mucaaleliyo, ovilela, osuwela ni ikuwo ineeneene saya.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Okumiha elatarato inama etthu emosa ehinooniwa okhala etthu na atthu, masi sintoko vaniiraneyaaya ni elatarato ekinaku, ncampulo nimosa nihaana mureerelo wa malove oophieryaka 1000.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Wiira okumihe elatarato inama sa mutakhwani, namalatha ohaana okhalana ilenti tele-opuxetiiva soorakamela, onasuwanyeyakaru wiira macampulo nkhama nikhuru na axipalame wala ekiriyatuura ekinaku eniphaveleya okhala muthinto mukinaku wa ilenti.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Inama sinceene soorika wooneya ti soohikhweya ophwanya, ni ipaarikhi okathi mukinku khasireerane ireerkera wi olathe ilatarato  wi sirumeeliwa munakosoni.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Inama sa mutakhwani pooti okhala sooreera murima wala soonanara murima. Nlaka pooti okhala nooriirya, nooviha wa noonaanela.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Olumwenku wookhalana mattaava oophiyeryaka 5.000 oovirikana, yiirelaka mpantta atthu oophiyeryaka imilyawu 50 sa anamalavula wala ni akina tho.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Malove oolepiwa ti tho, ookhweya wiiwiya malove aya yaalavuliwaka. Eyo eniiriha mwaha wa intereesu, sinikhalaka soorika olavuliwa wa mananna oowiiwananeya.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Ilapo sinceene suulupale ti iye sinilavula inkeleexi ni, ni sikinaku, nyuwo pooti olipelela muxutto woolimitareya - otepexa waya atthu ale ari anamittompe.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Wuupuweleke wamphwanya mutthu a Manchester,  mmosa a Boston,  mmosa a Oxamayika ni mukinaku a Otiisineyi axantariki orexitawuranti ya Otoronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Awo anivaanelasa alamulaka ihantisi sa ilapo saya, alavulaka ni mattaava aya ni ixarakawu sa mapuro awo soovirikana.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Othuma eyoolya muhina mwa isuuperimerikaatu ti mananna ootepexa opunttheya oowiilyiha. Masi waahisuwele waapeya, mithanlelo sinikhala othuma soolya sookonxelariwa.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Wa khula okathi isuuperimerimerikaatu sinootepa sincereryaka soolya soovirikana soolikaneene. Mpakha ni sikinaku sinnikuttiheya mmikorowontani wala mananna makinaku ookuttiherya.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Ilapo sikinaku wala mithinto sikinaku sa ilooxa, wa khula nipuro nookhala nnakhala erexitawuranti, yootepexa okhuwala ihisapo saya.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Opake ni oteexe ikoopiya sa apoolisi anyu ni ekontaakitu ya sekuratoora anyu.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Awo anniphaveleya wooniherya entereesu ya e-mail ya sekuratoora ni manummeru aatelefooni interinasiyonaali para ikonseelyu/ mitthuniheryo ni opaka mikhanyereryo saya.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Muhaana okhalana ekoopiya ekinaku mmaalani mwanyu ni online (e-mail yawinyuru ni aneekisu, wala yoopwehiwa "mmeekuni").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Nyuwo mweetta ekwaha ni leepitoopi wala tablet, mmpweheke ekoopiya emosa mmemooriya mwanyu wala mutiixikuni mwanyu riixitu (muhinakhalaneru interineet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Ohiya tho vo, ikoopiya sa apoolisi ni sa ikontaakitu sa anamweetta ekwaha ni amusi wala apatthani aniphavela okhaliherya.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Maalisi kahiyo oowaaluwasa, masi awo anoorowa wiixaakiherya yapaciwa.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Okathi maalisi anoonasiwaaya ohikhala alipa oowoopiha, atthu animalela owaattamelasa ni khwiiruuhela sootakhala.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Ohaana owurya malinkwiti wa mananna ooreerela. Nlinkwiti nin'hapala wa mananna oovirikana, ni osuwela mukotelo anyu etthu yooreera.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Owurya nlinkwiti wa mananna oovikana mukotelo anyu nimmalela wuuruuhelane iretta muhina mwa ekumi anyu, mpakha omuhonona hapa anyu, ohoona ni mpakha owiivani. Aakhala malinkwiti anipakiwa voohitthuniheriwa ni kuveerunu, ala nto anootepa wuncererya myoopihelo saya.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Vano yakhala malinkwiti ale a mihali wala a ikhacu a mmwaani annikelasa axiitthu anincererya ootepexa woopopiha ekumi ahu, ntoko metanoooli, onimalela wuumiha wa wiiva, onawuriyakaru vakhaani vakhaani.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Iwookulu sinikhweya ehisapo aya ilapo iyesa ota, otepexa waya ilapo iye sookhweya itthu, okhala wiira iwookulu sa muteko siri vakhaani.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Mphaka opaka isaame ya eviixita otominsiiliyu, wakhala wiira sekuru onimuukhaliheryani, okuxe ewarakha olepeliwaawe ni opwehe mapuro ooreerela.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Arumasawu ootepexa orika ehisapo aya mapuro ala animalela okhalana mikacamiho saya: akinaku animalela okhala mitakiheryo, ni ale eekeekhayi animalela okhala ootepexa orika ehisapo aya ovirikana mulaponi mwanyu.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Ekafe ti commodities kamosa kamosa yootepexa opakiwa moolumwenkuni, ni munimalela ophwanya yoovirikana eriyari munikhalaanyu.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Wa siiso, yaakhala mananna oovirika oowurya ekafe  olumwenku wootheene ni ennireerela otteha.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (wala kaniyoniiximu) eniira mpantta wookela mphaka okuttoni wa cânion, onimalela okhala oowuuma wala oorukureriwa ni maasi.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Kaniyoniiximu oniiwanana ni ikaruma sookatelelana, exikalaata, otupha - masi enniphaveleya opaka eterenu yaamukhaani wala mananna oowooneya wa alipa ale anipacerya (yaalikanihiwaka ni miwelelo sa irooxa, wiiruweya mmaasini, wala esqui alipiinu, sintoko).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Weetta ti muteko a vamukaneya onitthuniherya weettta mapuro alea ephattu, okathi munceene ni itirilya sa mweettelo.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Myeetelo sa nihiku mutthu onnipixererya ekiloometuru emosa yoorakamela enimalelihiwa nihiku nenno.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Wa mweettelo wa nihiku nimosa wa etirilya yookweya, sinniphaveleya miilokiheryo vakhaani, ni khula mutthu ni mananna oniweryaawe ottottela muraarelo.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Amusi ale arina anamwane acikhaani ahaana okhala olikaneene saana, masi mipantta sikinaku sa ota oniiraneya, anakhalakaru axinamwane ni anamwane arina eyaakha yooweetta oxikola.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Olumwenku wootheene, sookhala milokiheryo soophiyeryaka 200 sa eturiiximu sinira miteko. Omwaattelo wa seyiya siniivare mmansaya.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Susesoora a Global Running Tours, a Go Running Tours onnaalupanyiha maforenesatoore oovirikana a "sightrunning" muhina mwa ikontinenti ixexe.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ni mphattuwelo wa Tours wa moomolano wa Opareseloona ni Okopenyaaki, khiyaapinse oxintta muhoolelo wa Tours wa moomolano waakhumelela Oparaka ni myoomolano sikinaku.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Khasireere itthu sinceene sinireerela oweha saana muhinatthi wala mweettaleene ekwaha.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Nyuwo mweettaka ekwaha, munilipelela woona itthu muhinoonaanyu owaani. Makhalelo, malamulo, malyelyo, mweettelo, murupelo, sooreerela, mattaava ni sikinaku, mpakha woona mirikano wa iye silimalenlaawe omuttettheni wawe.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Eyo ti etthu enireerela nyuwo wuupuwela muhinatthi wiinanariha, wala, mpakha ohuusivelani iye sinivariwa mapuro awo.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Maaxensiya a ekwaha akhumelenle okhuma miyaakha imiya XIX. Wa mutthu a ekwaha ti ooreerela omuvekela ekwaha okhala wiira onnisuwela sikinaku sa nlaka, nttaava wala ilapo iye sookhweya itthu.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Onasuwanyeyakaru wiira maaxensiya manceene annilikanana waakhulela mixukeryo sa atthu, atthu anceene anisuwela mithinto sinceene sa ikwaha, misurukhu saya wala mimalelo saya.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Vannireerela okhalana axenti anisukaka ikwaha soolikana ni sawinyu.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Muweheke ipakoti axenti onipuntthaawe, muweheke musayitini wala evitiriina ya axensiya.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Mwaphavela osuwela olumwenku voohirumeela musurukhu munceene, onakhalakaru vootthuneya, mukhalelo wa ekumi wala muxinttano, aakhala mananna makinaku oopaka iyo.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Voosuwanyeyavo, awo aniira mpantta wa ikatekoriya piili: anivara muteko ni ikwaha ni ale anitteha olimitari itixipeesa. Mwaha ola onilavula wa ele yookhiserya.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Wa ale aniphavela osakirifikari ekonfoorutu, okathi ni ovukula ihisapo mpakha ophiya khaveettu, ohaana oweha ihisapo sootepexa opunttheya.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Ekonseelyu enihimya wiira anamweetta ekwaha ahiiye, ahinvatiri, ahikhaleleke emerekaatu yoohitthuniheriwa ni kuveerunu, ahivekele muxontte wala owiixipolorari atthu akinaku mwaha wa iye siniphavelaaya.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Mapuro ale onithokociwa mukontho ole emikarasawu anikhalaka mapuro oopacerya weemeliwa wakhuruwiya muntteekeni, mmwaatiyani wala mukukutta mukinaku.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Wa atere a mmwiinanoni, ixipensawu sinipakiwa muhina mwa kampuyi eettaka  ni nyuwo muhaana okhala etokumentu ya itentitaati yoosuwanyeya mwaakela mikukutta iya kamosa kamosa.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Akampuyi oohiyu, apasapooriti anikuxiwaka ni mulipa ole animweettiha kampuyi wiira nyuwo mwaarupaka murepe saana.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Rexiixituru ti erekisiitu ekinaku eniira mpantta wa eporoseesu ya viixitu. Ilapo sikinaku, nyuwo muhaana wiilepiha  ni entereesu ya empa munikhalaanyu ni mawutoritaati a mapuro yaawo.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Eyo enimalela waasinariha itukumentu sikinaku opoliisiya wa mapuro yaawo wala okela oxukurya munivariwa miteko sa imikarasawu.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Wa ilapo sinceene sookhalana nlamu nkhamanno, mooteeli a mapuro awo anoorowa okhapelela mwiilepiho (muhaana okohererya).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Wa myaha sikinaku, atthu ale oomaka mapuro oohikhala turiixitika ahaana wiilepiha. Wa siiso, eyo ti enitepiha okhalina nlamulo nooriipela, nto muhaana woonenela muhinatthi orowa.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arikitetuura orina nkhama opuxeetu etesenyu ni mutekelo wa impa. Arikitetuura a nipuro noosuwanyeya okathi mukinaku ti anaaruuhelaka muriixita waha wa ukhalelo awe.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Impa sootekasiwa sinceene sinireera oweharu paahi, ni moonelo wa etifiisiyu yoorakama wala wa exanela yoopwehiwa saana, enimalela okhala mureerelo woosuwanyeya.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arikitetuura anniphwanyaneya mapuro makinaku, nkhama palanexamentu urupaanu, inxinyariya sivili, tekorasawu, design ya mpuwa ni ipayisaxiiximu.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Noonaka wiira anceene a atthu ti ale ookhalayi, nyuwo khamunikela ophwanya ekumi  yinceene yoosuwanyeya ya ohiyu mwaaheetteru ekwaha mpakha mukano wa Albuquerque wala Santa Fé.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Wa sootheene, ikasiinu sootheene soolepihiwa sinnikharipulela malinkwiti ni omwaatteloni wa iyo sinnivaha mihakalalo sooreerela (otepexa waya iye suulupale eriayri ya Albuquerque ni Santa Fé).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Phoole: ipaare sa ipooma ikhaani, moorukurereya mu, khasihiyo mapuro ootepexa waareerela atthu ale anixukurya ilapo sa ota.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Wa mpantta mukinaku, omukoni wa Noovu Meexiku sinikhala okhumelela milattu soowaatta mwaha mihapaleliyo sa atthu yeettihaka ekaaro,  ni muttottelano wa alipa aneettiha ekaaro onikhala ootepexa woonaneya ipooma iye ikhaani.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Imuraaxi wala irapiixiku soohitthuneya ti soosuwelaxiwa okhala ekarafiiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Ohiya okhala ottyaawene wa mukhumelelo wa niinaano, atthu anceene anaatakanxerya anamittompe okathi anipwanyulasaaya itthu sa atthu ootheene  ni soohikhala sa atthu ootheene ni sprays ya etinta.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Masi, niinaano va aakhala maaritiixita a ekarafiiti yookonsakarariwa, mikhumelelo sa ekarafiiti ni ixiri "sootthuniheriwa". Ipintuura sa iikarafiiti wampantta owo sinikhala ntoko iwoopora sa aariti ohiya itesenyu soohisuwelaxiwa.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Aremeesu a pumeranki ti musuwelo wa atthu  maturiixita aniphavelaaya oxutta.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Wa khala wiira nyuwo muniphavela oxutta mananna onivonyiwaawe pueranki  ni onatthikela matatani mwanyu, ohaana woona wakhala wiira mmatatani mwawo wookhalana pumeranki ooreerela opaka eyo.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Omwaattelo wa apumeranki aniphwanyaneya Waawuxitaraaliya, veekeekhayi, khanitthikela mapuro ale avonyiwaaya. Ale anixutta anileeliheriwa wiira ahinvonyeke okathi enoopa epheyo.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Eyoolya eniihaneliwa Hangi  enipakiwa vathi vooviha.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Mwiithe onivivihiwa ni maluku ooviha akumihiwe vayikho wala, mapuro makinaku, muvihelo xeyoteerimiku oniira mpantta wa eterenu yoovihana okhuma ephattu aya.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi onirumeeliwaka waaphavelaka waapeyiwa xantaari taratisiyonaali oowooxeriwa.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Mapuro makina oowaata Orotoruuwa annimuvaha hangi xeyomeetiriku, ni tho hangi akinaku pooti wooniheriwa elapo ya Christchurch, Wellington ni mapuro makinaku.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail ookhalana ikalaase piili muhina mwa akammpuyi a opooma ni aneetta mukano wa Epooma ya Okhaapu: MetroPus (tho onaasimeliwa ekalaase yoopacerya) ni Metro (onaasimeliwa ekalaase ya neeraru).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPus onnivaha mookomelo woopuheya ni ti ohintepexa osariwa, masi orikihiwa ehisapo awe, vanasuweleyakaru wiira ti ookhweya ehisapo awe orikana a metro a weewuroopa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Akampuyi ootheene aakhalana anamaxuttiha MetroPlus muhina mwa Metro. Anamaxuttiha MetroPlus anikhala wuumaleloni wa kampuyi oowaattaela Okhaapu Veeriti.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Waateexerya atthu akinaku - Muhikhalakhale murimeeliwaka niphuta nanyu, otepexa waya mwalapuwa miinano interinasiyonaali.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Munimalela orumeeliwaka nyuwo wi mukhala namakuxa a itoroka mwaha wa osuwelawanyu, ekhanle ti etthu enikela wuuruuhelani milattu sinceene.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Khonikhala olipelelaka mmulilani, okhala wiira animalela orumeeliwa alapwa ale annikhelela soowoopiha voohileeliha.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Ilapo sikinaku sookhalana ipunisawu iye saarumeeliwa khalayi, mpakha ni mareewu pirimaariyu; awo animalela olamula esentensa ya ekhatteya ya miyaakha 10 wala nlamulo na mukhwelo.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Mafuta oohikhapeleliwa ti anitepexa wiiyiwa  ni tho animalela owaatarayiri mawutoritaati anikhapelela myaha sa ipompa.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Mwaha wa mwaattelo wa exiposisawu ixeerime sikhanle owaani wanyu, sookhala milipelelo suulupale nyuwo okhala imuuni wa iyo.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Masi mipantta sikinaku sa Olumwenku, weyiwo efawuna pakiteriyootika ti etthu ya niinaano wa  nyuwo, ni nyuwo unimalela ophwanya milattu.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Ohiya tho vo, ikilima sootepexa oviha, axiitthu aninnuwasa voowaakuveya ni anikhala miyaakha soowaatta yakhala ota wa erutthu.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Nsa, imsa alitisawu Delhi Belly, Elitisawu ya Faraó, Evinkansa ya Montesuuma ni axipatthani awe oovirikana.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Yoolikana ni ele enikhumelela ikilima iye sootepexa oriirya, okathi onikhumelelaaya iretta  soowaatta sa mphumuni, iretta sa mmirimani okathi wooviha kasinthowaka ni, omwaateloni wa miyaha, ti sootepexa ohikhaliha saana, masi khasintepexa woopiha.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Nyuwo mweetta ekwaha yoopacerya murowaka elapo yoowinnuwihiwa  - wala wa nipuro na niinaano - muhikhootte ovira nipuro na ewahala.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Anamweetta ekwaha anceene ooxutta ni oosuwelaxa awo anikhala ottharelela ilapo sininnuwihana,  weyiwo milokiheryo sa iwaha icikhaani sinitakaneelaaya voowaakuveya.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Otepexa mahiku oopacerya, muupuweleke olya musurukhu anyu mooteeli, eyoolya ni miteko sooreera sa kwalitaati ni wa mukhalelo ositentaali wiira wuukhaliheryeni okela mukilimani.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Muhirupeke vanceene mapuro munoonaanyu wiira khamunsuwela sookhumelela sa mutakhwani mapuro yaawo.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Nyuwo mwarupa ota, muhaana okuxa emaaka ya murupelo wala ereeti wiira muhilumiwe ni inowa, anamareere ni itthu sikinaku.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Mureeriheke ekumi anyu ni ekafe yootepexa oreera ya voosiisu ni exa ya kamumiila  wiira murelaxari ohiyu.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
