text: Yaphiya mahiku anyu oomumula omutekoni, munookhalana  okathi oowiireherya ni okhalana iminuutu vakhaani oowaapeya etthu yoowoosivelani.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Nyuwo mweyixoonaka okhala namathamaleya, ottottele muraarelo wa omupaka suumu wala isipo sooreera.
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Nyuwo munialela woonenela nlinkwiti nookhweya munitthunaanyu opaka ekafe ya voosiisu, mwatthikela mmutekoni mwanyu.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Nyuwo mwaakhala epooma erina ewaha ya malinkwiti oovirikana, muroweke munitumihiwaaya wala pubs mapuro ale nyuwo muhineettelelaanyu.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Ale ahilimalenle nttonka meetiku, malove oovalihaniwa ni aakhalana isikinifikaatu soovirikana.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Eretta yoovalihaniwa ti ele eniphattuwa mwaha wa patooxenu, nkhama iviiru, mwaaxiitthu mmosa, efunku wala axunku akinaku.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Eretta yoovalihaniwa ti eretta yoowaakuva ophwanyihaniwa wa mwaattamela mutthu orina eretta eyo.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Ilapo sikinaku sinivekela wiira anamurwa wala ale anikhuma mulaponi ahaana ovasinariwa mwaha wa iretta soovirikana.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: makhalelo awo animaleela wiiraka mpantta wa elapo namweetta ekwaha oxukunraawe wala oniphavelaawe oxukurya.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Wa ikhoo kamosa kamosa sookhooala sa Charlotte, Okaroliina wa Onooriti, okhalaka wiira ookhala ampulansiya a mithanlelo sooreerexa muhina mwa amusi.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Alipa anikhala mpantta mukinaku annihimyaka waataano wa amusi nkhama emotiivu pirinsipaali wi athaamele weewu, anamaxukurya anoona waalokaserya epooma wiira yaakuxe anamwane.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Wuumaleloni wa miyaakha 20, mwaattelo wa mithanlelo sa anamwane elapo ya Uptown Charlotte yinnunwe voowaakuveya.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Wa sootheene, amusi awe Uptown Charlotte khanirumeela itaakisi, onasuwanyeyaru wiira awo pooti orumeela sakhumelela sookhumelela.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Yookhala ekoporansa ekinaku ya anamweetta ekwaha ayili, nto muthanlelo ola onimalela okhala ootepexa orika ovirikana ole woophaveleya.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antaaritita ti nipuro nootepexa oriirya muhina mwa epalaneeta ni enimurukurerya Poolu Ookuusini.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Miyeettakaso turiixitiku ti sootepexa orika, eniphaveleya okhalana mukhalelo wooreera ni woowooneya, masi sinipakiwa okathi ole wooviha (okhuma noovempuru ni fevereeru)  ni ti ilimitaata, mpantta oowaatta, Peninsula, iyiilya ni Ephareya Roosa.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Anamuteko anceene anikhala overawu waattamela ipaasi 48, otepexa waya mapuro awe; nummeru naamukhaani na atthu ninkhala nipuro nno nooriirya.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Muhina mwa Antaaritita ti palanaalutu muulupale ookhuneeleya wa 2 - 3 km.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Ixikurusawu sa musulu soosuwelela okathi sinnivolowa muhina, wiira opake emontayiiximu wala ophiya Opoolu, orina epaasi yuulupale.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Mulapuwelo wa Poolu Ookuusini (wala ephiro) ti etirilya ya 1.600 km ya Exitasawu ya McMurdo, oniphwanyaneya muhina mwa Ephareya ya Ross, mpakha Opoolu.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ti eneenve yookompakitariwa ni ifenta soottiyattiyiwa ni yookwerethiwa ni ipantera. Ela eneettiwa ni itaratoore soowiixipesiyalisariwa, silovolaka iterenu ni kopuxitiiveli ni isupirimentu.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Okhala wiira khasineetta vanceene, vaniphaveleya orukurerya Mwaako wootheene Taransantaaritika wiira ophiye opalanaalutu.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Etthu enitepa waakhumeleliha asitenti okathi wooriirya mwaha wa iphiro soothererya, ikalasaata (ikalasaata) ni, otepexa waya ixikatta.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Mmuyeveloni, nyuwo muhana okhalana ittamanko ni esoola yoolipa. Ittamanko siniwariwa okathi ole wooviha ti sootepexa othererya muxeeluni ni muneeveni, ni mpakha ipoota sikinaku siniwareliwa oriirya okathi mukinaku khasinreerela.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Eperifiili ehaana okhala yoowiixerya oratteene,  5mm (1/5 polekaata) wala yoovikana, ikaruma sihaana okhala soowoolowa wa itemperatuura saamukhaani.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Ipoota sikinaku sihaana ikarampu ni sookhalana asesooriyu ni ikarampu siniviraniwa moothererya, sooreerela wa isapatu ni ipoota sikinaku, sinnituphaniwa, ni otupha ni esoola.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Isaalutu sihaana okhala sookhuveya wala soowaatapuwa. Mithaaka, kaxikaalyu wala maakha (ekoloreetu ya kaalisiyu) sinikhala omwaramwariwa mphironi wala etirilya wi emureeriheke atarasawu.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Avalanches kahiyo oohiloka; miphiteeryo ikereemi sinniphiyererya mpakha ekhomo yoosuwanyeya, osuwanyeyaka wiira mwinnuwelo  woovikana onoomora nkhama avalanches.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Mulattu aya okhalaka wiira neeve nookhalana etexituura yoowaakuva ovara, ti vo eyo eniphavela aya etthu yoovarelana muteko, ni  namora neeve nimosa nimmalela omukhumeliha avalanche.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Okathi mukinaku, etthu eniiriha okhumelelaka mmorelo aya mwaha wa nsuwa ninvihiha eneeve; okathi mukinaku, enikhalaka vakhaani eneeve; okathi mukinaku, mikhumelelo sikinaku sa ephattu, ni okathi mukinaku onikhala mutthu.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Toronaatu ti ekoluna ya epheyo enirukurerya ni eperesawu yootepexa oyeva, enuula epheyo eniviravira ekeliha muhina ni musulu.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Awo annikumiheryo ipheyo suulupale (yoopiyeryaka imiilya/ewoora 100 - 200) ni pooti ovavihaka ikaruma soolemelela siroohaka musulu, siniteexa okathi ola toronaatu oniittikinyaawe.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Awo anipacerya sintoko ifunili sikhuruwaka mmeekuni mwa itempexitaati ni sinamakeya okhala "itoronaatu" okathi anikwanyaaya etthaya.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Anamavaha a  VPN (reeti pirivaata virituwaali) oohikhala akuveerunu ti mananna ooreerela wiira nirukurerye esensuura poliitika ni efilitaraaxi xeyokaraafika ya IP komeresiyaali.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Awo ti ootepexa winnuwa muhina mwa proxies a Web mwaha wa imotiivu soovirikana: Awo annileeliherya etaraafeku ya interineeti, ohiya paahi http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Awo anikhala ovaha epanta laaraka yuulupale ni miteko sooreera saana. Awo anikhalaka oowinkiripitariwa ni, wa siiso, ti voorika othurumela.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Impereesa sa eriyari mahiku ootheene animoothererya mphiyereryo aya, ahimyaka wiira awo ti mananna "oowiixaakiherana epiratariya".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Veekeekhayi, malamulo a mmwaani kharina mureerelo aya wa ekoopiya yookottihiwa; ekoopiya ya bit-a-bit ya etiixiku pooti orumiha voohimulattu muhina mwa khula tixipositiivu mwemmo onirumaawe orixinaali.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Mphiyereryo wa ekeekhayi ti ovaha impereesa iyo mithokoreryo soowaatta muhina mwa imerekaatu saya; sootheene iyo mwaha woophavela oviraviriha musurukhu.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Okhala wiira miitthanelo ti soorukureriwa ni interineeti, weeso khaavo mphaveleyo wookhalana operatoora telefoonika  munikhalaanyu wala weyiwo nyuwo munikelaanyu e weetta ekwaha.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Tho khorivo mukhanyereryo onihimiya wiira muhaana okhalana nummeru nimmosa na mutthetthe yoole munikhaanyu; nyuwo pooti okhala interineeti ni mukhaliheryo wa sateeliti muhina mwa etakhwa ya Chicken, Alaska ni othanla ninhimya wiira nyuwo muniphwanyaneya mapuro mooviha nsuwa Waarisoona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Nyuwo muhaana othuma nummeru kolopaali noohiyanihiwa ninaatthuniherya atelefooni  RPTC wuulikarelani. Weyiwo nummeru ninkhalanaaya muvirikano ni atthu ale aniwaattelani araame.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Apps a mutaphulelo a mutthaka okathi weekeekhayi - apilikatiivu arina owerya otaphulela niinaanoru mutthaka wa nttaava ni nttaava nikinaku.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Wa apilikatiivu ala kamosa kamosa pooti otaphulela mitthaka ni mattaava a ilapo sikinaku mwa ipalaka wala ikaruma sikinaku sa olumwenku eekeekhayi okathi mutthu onithoonyaawe ikaruma iyo ni smartphone.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Mananna ootaphulela khareere waakuva oreeriheya ni niinaano va anivaha mitaphulelo soolikanelana (ti voorika ophwanya oohitaphuleliwa oratteene), masi mphaka okhalana ephoole, awo nlelo pooti wiiwa wa mananna oovonyeya.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Wa maapilikatiivu ala ootepexa ohoolela mureerelo aya ti Google Namataphulela, onitthuniherya mitaphulelo off-line noopakiwa download wa itaatu sa nttaava nle nimphaveliwa.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Murumeelo wa maapilikatiivu GPS muselulaarini mwanyu animalela okhala mananna ootepexa okhweya ni ookhweya ophwanya mwakha ota wa elapo anyu.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Owo pooti wiinanela musurukhu othumelaka maapha mapheya wa GPS, wala tixipositiivu GPS oowiirumeela, wala omoolaka mmosa wa lokatoora a mikukutta.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Nyuwo mwaahikhalane ekonekisawu ya itaatu mutelefooneni mwanyu, wa owo wakhala ota wa alikansi, mureerelo awe onimalela okhala limitaata wala intixipensaaveli.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Khula elooxa yaamukhaani eri yoowiipitheya eniphwanyaneya yoorukureriwa ni ikaratawu pere-paaku sinirumeeliwa mmaaruni wala wa atelefooni oosuwelaxiwa.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Onasuwanyeru wiira ikaratawu soowaatta sirina muraarelo oopaka ilikasawu wa khula nipuro, akinaku arina owerya ovaha itarifa sooreerela muhina mwa makhuru a ilapo soosuweliwa.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Wiira mukhalane miteko muhaana okhala nummeru na telefooni, ni omwaatteloni wa myaha iya okathi mukinaku atthu animwaattaka oraame voohiliva etthu.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Ireekera siniirela mpantta wa elatarato rekulaare ennirumeeliwa mukaravasawuni wa iviitiyu, ni itthu sikinaku.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Yaahitthuniheriwe okumiha elatarato ya etthu emosa, nto nyuwo muhikaravari eviitiyu ya etthu yeeyo.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Nyuwo mwaarumeelaka etoroni, muhaana owehaweha muhinatthi, wakhala wiira onnitthunihiwa ofilimari ni mitthuniheryo xeene wala ilisensa siniphaveleya okhalana.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Weettiha etoroni mapuro owaattamela munimorela ntteeke wala eriyari ya atthu kehiyo etthu yooreera, munasuwelakaru wiira mootthuniheriwa.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Mahiku oolelo ti voorika wiixaathi nipuro na ekwaha ni ekompanyiya ya matteeke voohiwehaweha ihisapo saya toko.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Okathi mukinaku, ntteeke ni nimosaru nenno ninnikhalana ihisapo soovirikana wa ale aniphavela weetta ekwaha, ni owo onniliva wiira oweha mikhumelelo siniphavelaawe ni tho owehaweha wi owehawehe esayiti eneeneene ya ekompanyiya ohinathi wiixaatiha ekwaha awe.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Nyuwo muhinamphaveleviixitu oopaka mukwaha a mahiku vakhaani  wa ilapo sikinaku nkhama turiixita wala waapaka anakoso, orowa nwu sintoko naxikona a ilapo sa ota onoona okhalana suulupale ovirika ale anirowa nkhama turiixita kasuwaale.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Wa sootheene, okhala khula elapo ya ota wa okathi woowuncerereya onoona okhalana viixitu mukinaku mahiku ahinamale.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Mwaatteloni mwaya, aviixitu aanaxikola aakhalana irekisiitu saya ni mananna aya oomuvekelana oovirikana aviixitu ale a eturiiximu wala anakoso ookhala mwaaleyiwe.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Wa ilapo soowaatta, nyuwo munookela ophavela ewarakha yoolepiwa ni inxitituwisawu munikelaanyu osoma, ohiya okhalana mireerelo sinooniherya wirra nyuwo munirowa okhala mwaakha woopacerya.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Mukohererye toko winxitituwisawu, wala oteparatamentu munirowaanyu osoma, wiira musuwele miikhosaya.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ohinkhala wiira mwatipolomaata, ovara muteko ilapo sikinaku sa ota muhaana ovaha ihisapo sa musurukhu sinaakheliwa mulaponi mwanyu.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Wa ilapo soovirikana, impooxitu ya erenta erina makhalelo oovirikana, maalikoota ni ifaaxa sa mipooxito sinivirikana elapo ni ilapo.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Wa ilapo sikinaku Feteraali, nkhama EUA ni Okanata, impooxitu wa renta onilivihiwa wa mwinnuwelo feteraali ni wa nipuru munikhalaanyu, weeso, itaaxa ni ifaaxa sinivirikana nipuro ni nipuro.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Onasuwanyeyakaru wiira imikarasawu ti soohikhala wala eforomalitaati nyuwo mwaphiya mulaponi mwanyu, muxikhelelo atuwaneyiru onimalela okhala oonyoonyiha.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Muhaana osuwela etthu yooreerela oruuha wala hooye, ni muhaana ohimya etthu piitthu munoonaanyu wiira yoovikana mulemelelo oniphaveleya.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Mananna ootepexa okhweya opacerya mapuro a "olepa wa ikwaha" osuweleeha sooxutta sanyu muhina mwa blogue a ekwaha yiiranen'ye.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Nyuwo pooti opaka esayiti anyu mwalimalela vale opaka eforomatasawu ni etisawu muweepini.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Wiikumiherya eriyari ya ekwaha ti mananna ooreera wiixooniherya okhala mutthu oovirikana, masi kohiyo ovaha paahi.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Okhala ni ovara muteko wa mananna oowiikumiherya ilapo sikinaku sa ota ti etthu yootepexa oreera ni mananna ooreera oxutta iwahala soovirikana, waasuwela atthu akinaku, wiisuwela weeyo omwaneene awe, ophwanya miruku sa myuupulo sa ohoolo ni mpakha oxutta itthu sikinaku.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Ohiya iyo, pooti okhala mananna ooreera omwarya orosamentu ni wuncererya mahiku ookhala mapuro yaawo, okhala wiira miteko sinceene soowiikumiherya sinnivaha nipuro nookhala ni yoolya ni sikinaku sinnilivaha musurukhu vakhaani.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: vikings anirumeela ikanaali sa Oruusiya wiira aphiye Ephareya Neekuru ni Ephareya Kaaxipiyu. Mipantta sa iroota iyo poote orumeeliwa. Muweheke toko wakhala wiira sinookela ophaveliwa ilisensa ixipesiyaali, sinimalela okhala soorika ophwanya.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Wampwaheryo wa Ephareya Yootteela enimulupanya  Oseyaanu Aaritiku mpakha Ephareya Paalitiku, oviraka Laaku Ooneka, Laaku Latooka ni Sawu Petersburgo, omwaatteloni waya mironi ilaaku.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Laaku Oonea tho onilupanyeya ni Voollika, nto pooti ovira tho ephiro ya Ephareya Kaaxipiyu mpantta wa Oruusiya.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Mukhupaliki wiira mwakela ophiya mmariina, sootheene sinirowa okhala soowooneyaxa. Nyuwo munookela waasuwela anamweetta ekwaha akinaku yaamuwenle mwaatiya mmosaru ni nyuwo ni yiiwale mihupi sanyu.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Veekeekhayi, nyuwo munookela ohela iphoole muvahereryaka miteko sanyu, munookela weetta mutookani, munookela waaleela atthu akinaku wiira munnirapiha myaatiya, munookela otteha olavula mamariheeyiru mmwe muniwuriwa, ni sikinaku.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Muhaana ovaanelana atthu anceene. Noovira wa okathi, atthu anceene anookela wuusuwelani ni anookela wuuthoonyiheryani iphiro sa myaatiya aniphaveliwaatthu.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Nyuwo muhaana osuwela othanla empereesa anyu ayeereyo ni porokaraama a emilyaaxi eriyari ya aliyansa.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Nyuwo munuupuwelaru ophavela okhala wala wiirela mpantta empereesa ayeereyo munikhalaanyu owela ntteeke, muhaana osuwela wiira mireerelo sinivahiwa, okathi mukinaku, sinikhala soovirikana ni aporokaraama a emilyaaxi animalela okhala oottotteleya muraarelo wa ekompanyiya ayeereyo muhina mwa esixiteema yeeyo ya mupatthanano.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Ikompanyiya ayeereyo nkhama Emirates, a Etihad Airways, a Qatar Airways ni  Turkish Airlines khareere wooniherya miteko saya Owaafirika ni annivaha milupanyiho muhina mwa ipooma soowaatta sa Waafirika ni ihisapo sookhuwala ovirikana ikompanyiya sikinaku sa Weewuroopa.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines onnivava mpakha ivaara 39 wa ilapo 30 sa Waafirika okhuma mwaakha wa 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Nyuwo mwakhalana okathi ooweetta ekwaha, muweheke wakhala wiira ehisapo yoorowana Owaafirika ennilikana ni etarifa yootthikana.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Muhiliyana wuncererya ehisapo ya viixitu eexitara, a etaaxa ya empaarikhi, a mukukutta wa vathi, ni sikinaku. Wa mapuro ootheene a  ilapo sa ota sa Waafirika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Wa khala wiira munitthuna ovava mpantta wa Emixifeeriyu ya Okuusini, muthanlo wa matteeke ni onirowaaya ti wooyeva mwaha wa muthowelo wa matteeke taransiwooseyaaniya.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Khiivo nnakhala ekompanyiya emosa enilapuwa oseyaanu wa emixifeeriyu ya okuusini (ni SkyTean khonilapuwa iyo).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Wa siiso, Star Alliance  oneetta mootheene, masi khuneetta oleexiti wa Pasiifiku wa Okuusini, wa Osantiyaaku wa Oxile okelaka Otayiti, weyiwo ntteeke mwaha wa  LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Ntteeke nno kohiyo muthanlelo mmosaru mwaphavela omulapuwa Pasiifiku a Okuusini ni kooxita oweexiti a Waameerika wa Okuusini (muwehe vathi).
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: waakha wa 1994, mukano etinikamenti arimeeniya wa Nagorno-Karabakh wa Azerbaijão ohaakiherya ekhotto ni azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ni mukhaliheryo wa Arimeeniya, yaahipakiwa erepuupilika epheya. Siiso, khiivo elapo ekhanle saana - hata Arimeeniya - khosuweliwe ni atthu ootheene.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Miyaha tipolomaatika siniira mpantta ni mukano nlelo sinivira sihaaxaka miiwanano sa Arimeeniya ni Azerbaijão.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Ekanaali District (yootaphuleliwa ni nttaava olanteexi: Grachtengordel) ti etixitiriitu yoosuwelaxiwa erina mphattuwelo aya miyaakha imiya 17 enirukurerya  Binnenstad wa Amsterdã.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Etixitiriitu yootheene enooniwa okhala Nipuro na Epatirimooniyu ya Apinatamu ni UNESCO, mwaha wa ehisapo aya ya ewahala ni ihantisi simosaru, ni ihisapo saya sa eporopiriyetaati ti sootepexa winnuwihana mulaponi.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, enihimya okhala mihaava  mithanu, sinniphiyererya ikomuna thanu litoraaniya sa  Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ni Monteroosu siniphwanyaneya mukano italiyaana wa  Likuuriya.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Awo arisi eliixita ya Patirimooniyu Muntiyaali wa Uneexiku.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Mwaha wa miyaakha miyaakha sene, opayisaaxeni enrukaata ni kilivoosu, sinnitekiwaka itaraasu, ni miinanelo, ni atthu, arowaka mpakha mutexipinyateyiruni ni moonelo wa oseyaanu.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Mpantta wa xaarime awe onnooneya ohikhalana mwinnuwelo. Iphiro, akampuyi ni myaatiya sinnilupanya mittetthe, itthu sihiniphiyereriwa ni ikaaro otaru.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Mananna oovirika oolavuliwa nttaava na efaranseexi anilavuliwa Opeelixika ni Osuwiisa anivirikana vakhaani efaranseexi enilavuliwa Ofaransa, enalikanakaru vakhaani ni ovaaneleya.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Wa veekhaayaru, esixiteema ya mwaalakelo Opeelixika ni Osuwiisa farankoofuna yookhalana ivirikano saya sooveyaveya siri soovirikana ni Efaranseexi, ni mulavulelo wa malove makinaku nti oovirikana.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Siiso, mafarankoofunu ootheene a Opeelixika ni a Osuwiisa anixutta efaranseexipa yooreerela oxikola, wa mananna awo aniweryaaya wiiwa wa nyuwo mwaakela orumeela esixiteea ya mwaalakelo patarawu wa efaranseexi.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Wa mipantta soowaatta sa olumwenku, wuuvela ntata ti mananna oorera ni oopatthananeya ovirikana wiira "ehaali".
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Wa sootheene, Omalaasiya, masina mwa malayiyu mapuro oohiphiya epooma, enihimya wiira "murwe va", olikana ekatha yamuthoonyo  yookhuniwa nithetemanelaka erutthu, exeexitu enikhala orumeeliwa ilapo sinceene sa woositenti, ni yaakela orumeeliwaka paahi wa mutthuno yoowo.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Wa mananna yaawo, namweetta ekwaha piritaaniku Oxipaanya onimalila omulikanihaka aseenu ni muleeheryo, oopaka makuphi mutthu ole onikwata (ohiya mutthu ole onikwateliwa), nkhama mukwatelo ole wootthika.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Malavulelo ookhaliherya ti malavulelo oopakeleliwa wala oopakiwa wiira afasilitari muvaanelo wa atthu ale yaakela okhalana mikancamiho sa ovaanela.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Awo anihiyanihiwa ni mattaava faranka, ari to mattaava a ephattu wala moorokaanika anixintta mwaha wa exariya emosa nkhama ekaruma ya muvaanelo wa ale anilavula mattaava makinaku.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Wa oviha wa nihku, anamweetta ekwaha pooti otteha miyoonelo sinivaha muupuwelo wa maasi (wala etthu ekinaku)
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: So enimalela okhala etthu yoowoopiha namweetta ekwaha watthimakela myoonelo iyo, ohiyereryaka enerexiya yoowaarya ni maasi ahanle.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Mpakha eteseerutu  yootepexa oviha enikhala oriirya vayila  vale. Hipoterimiya ti moopihelo oohiwara ikuwo oovihaxa.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Okathi wooviha, nyuwo muhaana owuupuwelela apwilimwithi mwalakela weetta mutakhwani.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Muneettihakaru ekaaro eriyari ya etakhwa suputoropikaali, wa isekuntu vakhaani ni mikhora sootthukuliwa okathi ole muniphavelaanyu okela, owo okathi wooreerela okela pwilimwiti  ni nyuwo.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Ekiripi viyaariya, yoosuwelaxiwa okhala infuluwensa aviyaariya, enimalela waaphwanya axinuuni ni inama iyesirina mapele.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Wa myaha vakhaani aphwanyaniwe apinaatamu, masi wa  sikinaku  saari sootepexa woopiha.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Omwaatteloni wa atthu awo ti ale anivara ni alakhu, masi wa anamoona akinaku animalela okhalana eretta eyo.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Soolikana ni Soonoruweeka, ti ifiyooritiinkereemi ni ivaale  siniira niinaanoru, sinivaha nipuro epalanaalutu, yookhala moolikana.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Ipalanaalutu iyo sinikhala wooniwa ntoko "vidde", enihimya wiira nipuro nuulupale ni noohuleya voohikhala miri, exitensawu ilimitaata.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Wa Rogaland ni wa Agder awo anisuwelaxiwa okhala "hei", enihimya wiira exarineeka yoohimiri, yookhuneeliwa ni exitooroka.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Ixileyira khasihiyo sooreerela, masi sinitherekuwela mmwaako. Eyo enniruuhela mparuwelo, ifenta, sinimalela oriipelihiwa ni iponti sa neeve.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Wookhala mulipelelo wa ixiri ni itarato sa munikhukuni kalasiyaali okurumuwani ni miparuwelo otthukweya.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Mmaloothoni wa ikaleyira, ipulooku suulupale sinnihiyana, sinnimora okathi mukinaku sinnitupha wala sinnivitikelela ipoorota.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Okathi wa eturiiximu wa ixitasawu sa mwaako ninniphiyereryaka eepisi aya okathi ole wa muvihelo intiyaanu.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Siiso, awo aakhalanasa muthinto mmosa wa mureerelo ni xaarime okathi ole wooriirya, ni ixitasawu soowaatta sa mmwaako sinaakhela mwaattelo muulupalewa eneeve ni sinnivaha miteko nkhama esqui ni snowboard.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Wa ikompanyiya ayeereya vakhaani paahi sinivaha itarifa sa eluutu, sinivaha muvukulelo vakhaani wa ehisapo ya mukwaha wookhiserya okathi ole woovithiwa namukhwa.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Ikompanyiya ayeereya sinivaha itarifa iyo ti Air Canada, a Delta Air Lines, a Lufthansa wa matteeke ale anikhuma EUA wala Okanata , ni WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Wa myaha sootheene, nyuwo muhaana oxuka mukwaha mmurumeelaka telefooni voonineya ni ekompanyiya ayeereya.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
